on the approved regional MI Pack and Flash lets leadership ask questions on movements and risks with evidence from the pack.Process ImprovementEarlier APAC view for the Global Ops closeProcess · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · G16The automated regional consolidation supports the Global Ops close at WD+6 in 2026 and WD+5 in 2027, on the path to WD+3 by 2030 (register RHY-25).

ai.title: AI solution register 42
ai.html:
AI solution register 42

Every suggested step change and opportunity · feasibility to be confirmed with the LT and the TPI Opportunity Register · comments to be updated after the discussion
#WhereKindSuggestionToolsActivity type
As-Is → if adopted		FeasibilityRegister basis / LT comments
1Demand & Operational Inputs · Planning Inputs & Cycle Kick-off · step 1Step change · DigitalizationPlanning target and timeline published as a structured calendar
Global Ops publishes the targets, guidelines and detailed timeline as a SharePoint list / Planner plan instead of PowerPoint and Excel, so every planning stream subscribes to the same dates and target values and changes are notified automatically.		SharePoint list; MS Planner; Power AutomateManual → Semi-automatedImplementedTasks from Global Ops are already tracked on a SharePoint tracker (Global Ops accountable) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
2Demand & Operational Inputs · Planning Inputs & Cycle Kick-off · step 2Step change · AutomationVolume file pulled from the BP Portal on publication
Power Automate watches the GSC&S BP Portal publication and lands the preliminary and final production volume files (SKU level) in the Ops planning SharePoint with a completeness check against the site / SKU scope, removing the manual extraction and the waiting for the multiple feeds.		Power Automate; Power BI dataflow; SharePointSemi-automated → AutomatedImplementedGlobal has implemented a tool that feeds the volume for the COGM calculation automatically (GFS initiative, scaled for all sites) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
3Operational Planning · Operations Planning – Volume & Cost of Goods Manufactured modelling · step 1Step change · AISKU-level volume delta pack for the EF / NSP alignment
Python compares preliminary volumes with RBU2 and the ESF at SKU level and drafts the volume update request to NSP with the SKUs lacking FMC and the proposed reference SKU, so the alignment call works from one exception list instead of back-and-forth e-mails.		Python; Excel; TeamsManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global Supply ChainNot part of GFS scope; can be explored by NSP (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
4Operational Planning · Operations Planning – Volume & Cost of Goods Manufactured modelling · step 3Step change · AICOGM movement narrative drafted for the EF review
An agent reads the COGM dashboard and the Final VOP Review Form output and drafts the volume, FMC and mix movement explanation per brand for the EF sign-off, with the EF reviewer confirming or correcting each driver.		Copilot Studio agent; COGM dashboard (Power BI); OPS Cube flex formsManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global Supply ChainVolume variances are provided by NSP, as FP&A Ops does not have the insights (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
5Operational Planning · Global Logistic & Warehouse · step 2Step change · DigitalizationRate and driver tables feeding the distribution model
Freight rates, fuel surcharges, A2S plan and DC capacity are held as versioned driver tables in one SharePoint workbook feeding the primary and secondary template through Power Query, replacing re-keying across the two templates and keeping the business-case simulations on one driver set.		Excel Power Query; SharePoint; HyperionManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityA dashboard to gather external distributor information is being built as a first step (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
6Operational Planning · Global Logistic & Warehouse · step 3Step change · AutomationCheat sheet generated from the submitted templates
Python consolidates the regional templates and produces the cheat sheet draft (variances vs RBU2 by cost line with commentary placeholders) the same day the templates land.		Python; Excel; SharePointManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Global Logistics FBPConsolidation is performed by Global Logistics Finance (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
7Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · step 1Step change · AutomationExchange-rate version check between AZForce and OPS Cube
A validation compares the FX version, conversion logic and site totals in the AZForce push with the OPS Cube / Hyperion actualisation before the data is reviewed, flagging artificial USD variances so they are corrected once instead of repeatedly (register FPA-20).		Python; AZForce extract; Hyperion retrieveManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global OpsSuggested as feedback for Global to assess (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
8Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · step 3Step change · AutomationAutomated BSO reconciliation after the Planning Hub push
After the AZForce push a scripted retrieve compares FTE and manpower cost by cost centre between AZForce Final and OPSPR and publishes the differences, replacing the manual verification across systems.		Python; Hyperion Smart View retrieve; AZForceSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredAt ideation stage, not started; plan to pioneer with the Wuxi planning tool (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
9Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · step 4Step change · DigitalizationRecharge and depreciation inputs on a shared tracker
Global IT and Global Quality enter the depreciation recharge allocations by site on a SharePoint list with due dates and Power Automate reminders; the OPEX template reads the list, so clarification loops between Global IT, GQ, the GFS analyst and site finance are replaced by one visible status.		SharePoint list; Power Automate; Excel Power QueryManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global OpsSuggested as feedback for Global to assess (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
10Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · step 5Step change · AutomationTemplate-to-Planning-Hub upload validation
The confirmed OPEX templates are validated (cost centre, GL mapping, GQ target check) and converted to the Planning Hub load format by script, so the upload and business rules run without manual reformatting.		Python; Hyperion load formatManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAt ideation stage, not started; plan to pioneer with the Wuxi planning tool (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
11Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · step 6Step change · AutomationThree-way reconciliation report (AZForce · templates · Planning Hub)
One Power BI page reconciles site costs between AZForce, the offline templates and Planning Hub by cost line and flags the differences, so the GFS review starts from exceptions.		Power BI; Hyperion retrieveManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAt ideation stage, not started; plan to pioneer with the Wuxi planning tool (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
12Operational Planning · CAPEX Planning · step 1Step change · DigitalizationCapital spend collected in a form instead of e-mailed templates
Site Project Managers, GERE, Global IT and Global Quality enter CY phasing, CY+1–CY+5 totals and Total Project Cost per project in a Power Apps form validated against the CAS approved funding, so EF consolidates from one source instead of chasing template versions.		Power Apps; CAS extract; SharePointManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global OpsTemplates are maintained by the Global team (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
13Operational Planning · CAPEX Planning · step 3Step change · Process ImprovementTiered CAPEX review slides by site spend
Sites spending below USD 5M use a one-slide CAPEX summary generated from Hyperion; the expanded review slides are kept only for the larger sites, protecting the simplification intent during the tight cycle.		PowerPoint template; Power BI CAPEX dashboard exportManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside KL scope · Global OpsSuggested as feedback for Global to assess (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
14Operational Planning · CAPEX Planning · step 4Step change · AutomationRFD review pack generated from Hyperion
The Excel reports for the Ops RFDs and the post-review change log are generated from the Hyperion capex data by script, with changes written back through a controlled list, replacing manual report preparation.		Python; Hyperion retrieve; SharePoint listManual → Semi-automatedNot feasibleThe review pack is retrieved directly from ASO, without versioning stored in the ASO upload (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
15Operational Planning · Product Costing (FMC & SCC) · step 1Step change · AIMaster-data and SCC completeness screening
A model screens BoM, recipe, PIR and APO (TLanes, deletion flags) data for the costing SKUs and lists the gaps that would break SCC value-chain completeness or leave demand SKUs uncosted, before the dry runs.		Python; SAP / APO extracts; Power BIManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Global Product Costing and Manufacturing Finance HubNot part of GFS KL scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
16Operational Planning · Product Costing (FMC & SCC) · step 4Step change · AutomationSCC review pack built from the costing run
The brand review workbooks (SCC by market and brand vs prior cycle) are produced by script from the costing output, so the multiple review rounds work on one refreshed pack.		Python; Excel; PowerPointManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Global Product Costing and Manufacturing Finance HubNot part of GFS KL scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
17Operational Planning · Inventory Planning · step 1Step change · AutomationPrice-gap closure from the GCC report by rule
SCC-to-APSR mapping and price gaps are closed by a scripted lookup against the GCC report and the Product Costing price list, leaving only true exceptions for the Inventory team.		Python; APO / APSR extracts; GCC reportSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Global Inventory LeadNot part of GFS KL Ops scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
18Operational Planning · Inventory Planning · step 2Step change · AutomationBPP-to-Planning-Hub reconciliation on load
The gross inventory load is reconciled automatically between BPP and Planning Hub by SKU and site, with the differences published to the Inventory team before the provision run.		Python; FDH submission portal; Hyperion retrieveSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Global Inventory LeadNot part of GFS KL Ops scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
19Operational Planning · Inventory Planning · step 4Step change · AIProvision review pack with anomaly flags
Provision and MV proposals are compared with the 12-month history and NPI list and unusual movements are flagged with a draft explanation for EF and the RFD review, so the review focuses on the exceptions.		Python; Power BI gross and provisions dashboardManual → Semi-automatedImplementedA Gross and Provisions Power BI dashboard has been introduced by the Global Inventory Team (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
20P&L Modelling & Forecasting · Productivity Planning & Cost per Unit · step 2Step change · AutomationP&L-to-FMC reconciliation check on submission
On submission the bridge totals are reconciled automatically to the FMC efficiency dashboard and the productivity target, returning the differences the site has to explain.		Power BI; Python; DatabookSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Ops Reporting TeamNot part of GFS KL Ops scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
21P&L Modelling & Forecasting · Productivity Planning & Cost per Unit · step 3Step change · AutomationCost per unit schedules generated from the submission
The PET-area CPU schedules and graphs are generated from the COGM and volume submission by script, reconciled to the site total, instead of being built in the pack.		Python; Excel site / region packManual → AutomatedCan be exploredOutside KL scope · Ops Reporting TeamNot part of GFS KL Ops scope (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
22P&L Modelling & Forecasting · Site P&L and Review Packs · step 5Step change · DigitalizationActivity tracker fed by the planning systems
MS Planner tasks are closed automatically from system events (AZForce push, Planning Hub submission, sign-off records) and the Steerco sees a live adherence dashboard instead of a daily manual check.		MS Planner; Power Automate; Power BISemi-automated → Semi-automatedImplementedOps planning trackers are maintained in MS Planner by the Global Planning team and tagged to the relevant team members (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
23Planning Review and Sign-Off · Planning Review and Sign-Off (Site → Region → Group) · step 1Step change · AISite review cheat sheet per site (Agent Charlie)
A three-point summary per site with risks and opportunities, drafted by Agent Charlie from the site output pack, gives the RFD and EF the 20% of insights that matter ahead of the review (register RHY-06).		Agent Charlie (Copilot Studio); site output packManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityPossible improvement with the existing agent (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
24Planning Review and Sign-Off · Planning Review and Sign-Off (Site → Region → Group) · step 2Step change · AutomationPost-review adjustment log with controlled upload
EF confirms the post-review adjustments on a SharePoint list; the adjustments are converted to the Planning Hub load and reconciled by script, with the log as the change evidence.		SharePoint list; Python; HyperionManual → AutomatedNot feasiblePost-review adjustments involve discussion by EF with the respective budget owner or site lead (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
25Month-End Actualization · Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close · step 1Step change · AutomationScheduled pre-close checks with an exception list
The MAP PPV / POV and SOAR VOP / COP checks run on a schedule (Python on the BW extracts) and publish one exception list per site; new cost centres and GLs are validated against the Ops P&L mapping from the master-data feed (register FPA-04, FPA-05).		Python; SOAR / BW extracts; Power BIManual → AutomatedCan be exploredAutomated scheduling of the SOAR BW extracts with Python is constrained by the SOAR BW access security requirement; can be implemented once that requirement is addressed (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
26Month-End Actualization · Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close · step 2Step change · AutomationJournal pack prepared from standard calculations
Recurring judgemental journals (provisions, accruals, reclasses) are calculated from governed inputs and the SAP upload file is generated with the supporting evidence; Coupa accrual lines are enriched with the PO text from the P2P extract so variance analysis is possible.		Python; SAP JV upload; Coupa extractManual → Semi-automatedNot feasibleThe majority of journal entries are judgemental and may not follow a repetitive rule; automating them may not bring the impact and ROI (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
27Month-End Actualization · Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close · step 3Step change · AutomationP&L Review file built from the FDH staging layer
The six BW retrieves, the GD13 downloads and the ASO retrieve are replaced by a scheduled build of the P&L Review file from the Manufacturing Finance Data Hub staging layer, with the reconciliation tab produced automatically (register FPA-03, FPA-15).		Finance Data Hub; Python; Power BIManual → AutomatedNot feasibleNot feasible as proposed: the FDH data originates from SAP / SOAR BW, so the upstream SAP / SOAR source cannot be removed or replaced by reconciling solely within FDH (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
28Month-End Actualization · Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close · step 4Step change · AutomationSAP → SOAR → FDH → ASO reconciliation in Power BI
The final reconciliation uses the governed SAP vs ASO comparison with drill-through evidence (already live for site cost) extended to the full P&L and CAPEX, flagging the missing documents and the FDH calculation-logic differences that cause the recurring unreconciled items (register FPA-06).		Power BI; FDH; SAPManual → AutomatedCan be exploredFeasible provided the FDH team is actively involved, as the required data granularity is currently available only through the FDH team (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
29Month-End Actualization · Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close · step 5Step change · AIDraft MI commentary and sign-off pack for the EF / CFO review
The draft commentary for the review is generated from the reconciled P&L and the variance drivers and the sign-off evidence is captured in a form, so the review meeting works from a prepared pack.		Copilot Studio agent; OBIEE OPS014117; Power AppsManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityAn AI agent could generate the draft MI Pack commentary, provided the planning assumptions are visible - this is the ultimate goal (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
30Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 1Step change · AIVolume and COGM variance drivers screened by rule
Variances above the site threshold are extracted by rule from the OBIEE reports and the NSP volume commentary (pulled forward to WD+1) is attached, so the analyst explains drivers instead of locating them (register RHY-22, RHY-23).		Python; OBIEE extracts; TeamsSemi-automated → Semi-automatedImplementedImplemented through the threshold logic of +/- $0.2m agreed with NSP (Power BI) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
31Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 2Step change · AutomationPPV, ROX and yield analysis
The MAP PPV & RoX and yield analyses by material and brand are produced by script with the threshold applied, leaving the analyst the investigation of the flagged items.		Python; SOAR / BW MAP reports; Power BISemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredAutomated SOAR BW PPV, ROX and POV with Python is constrained by the SOAR BW access security requirement; can be implemented once that requirement is addressed. The PPV and Yield dashboard has been deployed to support the analysis (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
32Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 3Step change · AutomationSite Cost & FTE dashboard as the single analysis source
Manpower and non-manpower analysis runs on the governed Site Cost & FTE dashboard (automated SAP extraction, SAP vs ASO reconciliation, multi-comparator views) with unattended scheduling and AI anomaly flags for the first-layer review (register FPA-01, 02, 06, 07, 08, 10).		Site Cost & FTE dashboard (Power BI); Python; Power AutomateSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredAutomating the SAP data extraction and replacing the manual ASO retrieve with FDH is under exploration; the data reconciliation is already automated (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
33Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 5Step change · AutomationProvision and write-off analysis from the SOAR report by rule
The inventory provision and write-off movements are extracted and compared with the comparator and the EF provisioning review by script, with the local planner inputs captured on a list.		Python; SOAR inventory provision report; SharePoint listManual → AutomatedImplementedOngoing project to introduce the Actual Inventory Write-off and Provision Dashboard (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
34Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 6Step change · AIVariance screening and driver table shared with the FP&A P&L project
One rule set screens drivers above the threshold across all P&L lines and stores site, category, value, direction, driver and timing tag in a monthly table, so the conclusion is built on a consistent driver list and Power BI shows repeat drivers (register RHY-17, RHY-29, FPA-10).		Python; Power BI; SharePoint listSemi-automated → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityIncorporate the variance screening and driver table in the AI agent that generates the draft MI Pack commentary (same solution as Month-End step 5) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
35Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 1Step change · AIFirst-pass commentary drafted from the driver table
An agent drafts the commentary per P&L area from the extracted variance values and the timing / structural tag, in the agreed commentary standard, and routes it to the analyst for validation (register RHY-04, RHY-12, FPA-12).		Copilot Studio agent; Python driver extract; Power Apps commentary captureManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunitySame solution as the AI agent for the draft MI Pack commentary (Month-End step 5), provided the planning assumptions are visible (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
36Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 2Step change · AutomationLean P&L view linked into the MI Pack
The Lean P&L view is embedded from the Power BI app into the MI Pack template instead of being copied manually, so the template refresh covers every slide.		Power BI embedded visuals; PowerPointAutomated → AutomatedImplementedImplemented (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
37Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 3Step change · AIOne commentary template and an evidence check before the site pack is issued
Every site pack uses one commentary header and line format (sign, unit, Fav / Adv) and the drafted commentary is checked against the dashboard measures, comparator and thresholds before publication (register RHY-27, FPA-23).		Master MI Pack template; AI evidence checker (Python + LLM); Power BISemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCan be explored (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
38Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 1Step change · AINatural-language Q&A on the pack during the EF review
EF and the analyst query the governed dashboard in natural language during the review (which function drove the manpower increase, which comparator explains the variance) with cited measures, cutting the waiting time between review rounds (register FPA-11).		Power BI Copilot / Q&A; Site Cost & FTE dashboardManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityDo-able for actual data, as SAP posting details are available for Q&A with the right prompts; variance analysis versus planning is limited at this stage (see Month-End step 5) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
39Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 2Step change · DigitalizationSign-off and pre-read evidence captured in a workflow
The pre-read distribution and the site CFO / Head of Finance approval are captured in a Power Automate approval with the evidence stored against the period, meeting Core FSC009-001 without e-mail trails.		Power Automate approvals; SharePointManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOngoing FAST+ project uses Power Automate to obtain the CFO / Head of Finance approval - to adopt FAST+ (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
40Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 3Step change · AIAgent Rhy run hardened and triggered automatically
Completeness check on the nine site packs, period / version guard, automatic trigger when the final packs land, totals tied back to the Ops P&L report and a run log with fallback route make the Rhy consolidation reliable in every close, with business judgement kept as the final review (register RHY-01, 08, 09, 11, 13, 15, 16, 21).		Agent Rhy (Copilot Studio); Power Automate; SharePoint; Power BISemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCan be explored (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
41Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 1Step change · AIConsolidated APAC risks and opportunities view for leadership
Each site's R&O table (likelihood, timing, USD m) is rolled up into one regional list with the Flash, so leadership sees the forward view with the pack (register RHY-18).		Agent Rhy output; Power BIManual → Semi-automatedImplementedAgent Rhy is able to provide this (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
42Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 2Step change · DigitalizationTier-meeting actions tracked on one list feeding the next pre-close
Insights and actions from the weekly tier meetings are logged on a SharePoint list linked to the site and P&L line, so the next pre-month-end checks and the next cycle start from the open actions.		SharePoint list; Teams; Power BIManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside GFS scope · Site CFO / RFDOutside the GFS scope; can be explored by the site CFO / RFD (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)

Opportunity scoring (LT review, 26 Oct 2026): Can be explored · Implemented · Not relevant · Potential future opportunity · Not feasible. Implemented and Not feasible items are removed from the map. A dashed tag below the scoring marks opportunities outside the KL scope and the accountable team.

Feasibility and LT comments are held in the page data (window.FPAMAP.tobe.review, keyed by process id and step) - update them there after the LT discussion, or send the TPI Opportunity Register and they will be mapped in.

Natural-language Q&A on the pack during the EF reviewEF and the analyst query the governed dashboard in natural language during the review (which function drove the manpower increase, which comparator explains the variance) with cited measures, cutting the waiting time between review rounds (register FPA-11).
Power BI Copilot / Q&A; Site Cost & FTE dashboard

Do-able for actual data, as SAP posting details are available for Q&A with the right prompts; variance analysis versus planning is limited at this stage (see Month-End step 5) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 2

Sign-off and pre-read evidence captured in a workflowThe pre-read distribution and the site CFO / Head of Finance approval are captured in a Power Automate approval with the evidence stored against the period, meeting Core FSC009-001 without e-mail trails.
Ongoing FAST+ project uses Power Automate to obtain the CFO / Head of Finance approval - to adopt FAST+ (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 3

Agent Rhy run hardened and triggered automaticallyCompleteness check on the nine site packs, period / version guard, automatic trigger when the final packs land, totals tied back to the Ops P&L report and a run log with fallback route make the Rhy consolidation reliable in every close, with business judgement kept as the final review (register RHY-01, 08, 09, 11, 13, 15, 16, 21).
Agent Rhy (Copilot Studio); Power Automate; SharePoint; Power BI
Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 1

Consolidated APAC risks and opportunities view for leadershipEach site's R&O table (likelihood, timing, USD m) is rolled up into one regional list with the Flash, so leadership sees the forward view with the pack (register RHY-18).
Agent Rhy is able to provide this (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 2

Tier-meeting actions tracked on one list feeding the next pre-closeInsights and actions from the weekly tier meetings are logged on a SharePoint list linked to the site and P&L line, so the next pre-month-end checks and the next cycle start from the open actions.
Potential future opportunityOutside GFS scope · Site CFO / RFD
Outside the GFS scope; can be explored by the site CFO / RFD (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)

FPA-04Automated cost-centre master-data onboardingConnect the dashboard mapping layer to an authoritative, more frequently refreshed master-data source so newly created cost centres are recognised without manual maintenance.AutomationYesNoYes — FP&A Ops, DRM/master-data owner, IT: Automated cost-centre master-data onboarding.Existing July registerFeasibleReviewed and aligned
FPA-05Standard finance mapping across sites and SAP instancesMaintain approved mappings for cost centre, management unit, function, site, wrap/rep level and comparator definitions once, then consume them consistently in Python and Power BI.Process ImprovementYesNoYes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, R2R, master-data owners: Standard finance mapping across sites and SAP instances.Existing July registerFeasibleReviewed and aligned
FPA-06Power BI reconciliation between SAP and ASOUse governed dashboard logic to compare SAP Actual and ASO Actual, highlight variances and retain drill-through evidence so users review exceptions rather than manual formulas.AutomationYesNoNoExisting July registerAlready implementedReviewed and aligned
FPA-07Multi-comparator dashboard analysisKeep budget, RBU2LTP, prior-year and phased-month views in one governed dashboard to reduce separate files and improve variance explanation.Process ImprovementNoNoNoExisting July registerAlready implementedReviewed and aligned

Implement a Power Automate workflow that enables GFS analysts to trigger standardized stakeholder communications, including the relevant data and context, once site cost figures have been finalized for review in Power BI.
FPA-09Direct commentary capture through Power AppsReplace the Excel-based commentary source with controlled Power Apps input linked to the relevant site, period, measure and owner, improving traceability and concurrent use.AutomationYesNoNoExisting July registerCan be implemented in the futureReviewed and aligned
FPA-10AI anomaly detection for first-layer reviewFlag unusual variances, outliers and mapping exceptions by site, function, wrap/rep level and month so analysts can focus commentary on the highest-value movements.AIYesYesNoExisting July registerFeasibleReviewed and aligned with further input. Define differentiated thresholds for each site to reflect variations in site size and operational scale.
FPA-11Natural-language Q&A over the dashboardAllow authorised users to ask governed questions such as which function drove a manpower-cost increase or which comparator explains a variance, returning cited measures and drill paths.AINoYesNoExisting July registerCan be implemented in the futureReviewed and aligned

A like-for-like comparison between Actuals and Planning may be challenging with the current dataset for the following reasons: 1. Different levels of granularity: Actuals are available at the general ledger (GL) level, whereas Planning data is maintained at a higher level, such as the WRAP level. 2. Planning assumptions are not captured: The underlying assumptions used for the Planning figures are not currently stored in the dashboard, which limits the ability to explain or reconcile variances.
FPA-13AI commentary and decision-support guardrailsDocument that AI can explain, summarise and validate but cannot own finance conclusions; require source citations, reviewer approval, prompt/version control and retained output history.Process ImprovementNoYesNoExisting July registerFeasibleReviewed and aligned with further input The AI commentary might only be able to generate relevant decision-support insights when sufficient planning granularity and the underlying planning assumptions are available (as mentioned under FPA-12).
FPA-14Power BI granularity and performance optimisationAssess the month-phasing drill hierarchy and redesign the model so additional rep-level detail can be exposed without unacceptable dashboard performance.Process ImprovementNoNoYes — FP&A Ops, data science/Power BI team, site finance: Power BI granularity and performance optimisation.Existing July registerCan be implemented in the futureReviewed and aligned

FPA-16Dashboard design exchange with CAPEXReuse the site/business-unit lens, comparator selection, drill-through and reconciliation presentation pattern in future CAPEX dashboards while keeping CAPEX-specific measures and controls.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — FP&A Ops, CAPEX: Dashboard design exchange with CAPEX.Existing July registerNot relevantThe SAP data source, dimensions, and mapping for Capex differ from those used for Site Cost. Therefore, it may be challenging to leverage the same dashboard without significant changes to the data model and reporting logic. However, we could only leverage selected standard Power BI page layouts as a reference, ie: SAP versus ASO data reconciliation; Standardised comparator selection.

FPA-18Shared run calendar, backup ownership and support modelUse one workday calendar, primary/backup ownership, capacity monitoring and failure alerts so the monthly process does not depend on one PIC and technical support can engage quickly.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, R2R, data science/platform team: Shared run calendar, backup ownership and support model.Existing July registerFeasibleReviewed and aligned
FPA-19AI-assisted cost-centre mapping recommendationSuggest department, site and wrap mappings for new cost centres from approved historical patterns, with a master-data owner approving every mapping.AIYesYesYes — FP&A Ops, DRM/master-data owner: AI-assisted cost-centre mapping recommendation.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
FPA-20Automated local-currency and USD bridge validationValidate exchange-rate version, conversion logic and site totals across local-currency and USD views before the dashboard refresh completes.AutomationYesNoYes — FP&A Ops, Treasury, Controlling: Automated local-currency and USD bridge validation.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
FPA-21Planning-assumption ingestion and granularity bridgeCapture planning assumptions and approved allocation rules so actual GL detail can be compared consistently with higher-level planning data.AutomationYesNoYes — FP&A Ops, Planning, site finance: Planning-assumption ingestion and granularity bridge.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
FPA-22AI data-quality root-cause assistantSummarise failed reconciliations and trace likely causes to source, mapping, timing or master-data changes for analyst review.AIYesYesYes — FP&A Ops, data platform, master-data owners: AI data-quality root-cause assistant.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
FPA-23AI commentary evidence checkerCheck drafted commentary against dashboard measures, comparator, period and thresholds and flag unsupported statements before publication.AIYesYesYes — FP&A Ops, Controlling: AI commentary evidence checker.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
FPA-24Predictive refresh-failure monitoringUse run history and source delays to flag refreshes likely to miss the close timetable and recommend the correct support route.AIYesYesYes — FP&A Ops, platform support: Predictive refresh-failure monitoring.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—

rows: Agent Rhy reads all site MI Packs and drafts the APAC consolidation
Agent reads the 9 site packs in SharePoint and drafts regional commentary. Baseline 31 hours a month; 9.5 hours delivered.
Ask Rhy for the key points per site, e.g. two executive summary points per site for the month, with source citations.
Driver-based output in one fixed structure
One line per driver: site, Fav/Adv, $m, driver. Grouped by COGM, variable, fixed, other cost, FTE and capex; top 1–4 per category.
Timing versus structural tag on every driver
The instruction set classes each driver as timing or structural, so the forecast impact is visible in the commentary.
Agent Charlie for APAC planning pack consolidation
Same approach for planning packs, in testing during the MTP cycle. Gives a regional headline by cost category.
Site concise summary and cheat sheet for site reviews
Charlie gives a three-point summary per site with risks and opportunities, focused on the 20% of insights that matter.
Riff agent for slide-specific comments across site decks
Consolidates one named slide, e.g. Direct & Indirect Split, across all site packs into a regional headline.
Keep business judgement as the final review step
Analysts validate and refine every draft. The deck shows a wrong Wuxi capex driver corrected only after a challenge.
Stabilise the agent before relying on it in close
Stable in 3 of 7 test months. Issues: instructions ignored, missing site, usage limit, unknown errors, prior-month carry-over.
Protect capacity for testing, refinement and upskilling
6 of the 9.5 hours saved each month are reinvested in learning and optimisation. Net gain is about 11%.
Completeness check before the agent runs
Power Automate lists the files found against the 9 in-scope sites and stops the run if a pack is missing or still in draft.
Extract the numbers with Python, let the agent write the words
Pull variance values by rule, not by the model. The agent then explains drivers only, which removes most accuracy rework.
Tie agent totals back to the Ops P&L report
Compare each category total with the Ops P&L Power BI figures and flag any gap before the draft is shared.
Use the Site Cost & FTE dashboard as the source for cost and FTE numbers
The July dashboard already holds governed site cost and FTE data. Rhy can cite it instead of reading values from slides.
Period and version guard on the knowledge hub
Check month and Final/Draft status on each file before reading, and archive old months so prior commentary cannot carry over.
Trigger the run when final packs land
Power Automate starts Rhy once all final site packs are in the folder and posts the draft to Teams. No manual prompting.
Store the driver output as a monthly table
Save site, category, value, direction, driver and timing tag each month. Power BI then shows the variance bridge and repeat drivers.
Consolidated APAC risks and opportunities view
Roll up each site's R&O table (likelihood, timing, $m) into one regional list. North Ryde alone shows $1.7m up, $2.2m down.
Golden test month for regression testing
Rerun one validated month after every instruction or model change and compare with the approved commentary.
Hold the Rhy, Charlie and Riff instructions and standard prompts per comparator in one place with change history.
Run log, correction tracker and fallback route
Log each run, error and analyst correction in a SharePoint list, and agree the manual path for months the agent is down.
Volume commentary pulled forward to WD+1 with Global Supply Chain
GFS sends key brands to NSP on WD-4. NSP inputs by end WD-1, GFS picks up on WD+1 AM and drafts for site finance on WD+2.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Global Supply Chain (NSP), site finance: Volume commentary pulled forward to WD+1 with Global Supply Chain.
Threshold or Pareto rule for brands needing commentary
A defined threshold for Wuxi and Maihara, or a Pareto (80/20) basis, sets which brands NSP comments on. Gives NSP more time.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Global Supply Chain (NSP): Threshold or Pareto rule for brands needing commentary.
Standardised commentary across products and markets
One commentary standard agreed with GSC on volume data and reporting assumptions, replacing site-by-site variations.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Global Supply Chain, site finance: Standardised commentary across products and markets.
Earlier APAC view for the Global Ops close
Supports the Global Ops close at WD+6 in 2026 and WD+5 in 2027 (tentative), on the path to WD+3 by 2030.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Global Ops, site finance: Earlier APAC view for the Global Ops close.
Align GFS and Embedded Finance expectations
The deck asks for alignment, collaboration and proactive feedback so the agent output is meaningful and value-adding.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Embedded Finance: Align GFS and Embedded Finance expectations.
One commentary template for every site pack
Fix the headers and line format in the master pack. North Ryde mixes $0.98M adv, $(0.07)M adv and $0.03m fav on one slide.
Yes — FP&A Ops, site finance: One commentary template for every site pack.
Offer the agent pattern to other Ops regions
Site packs use the global Master MI Pack core slides, so the same instructions can serve other regional consolidations.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Global Ops: Offer the agent pattern to other Ops regions.
Shared variance-screening logic with the FP&A P&L project
Both projects pick out drivers above a threshold. Agree one rule set so site and market commentary read the same way.
Yes — FP&A Ops, FP&A: Shared variance-screening logic with the FP&A P&L project.
Validate capex drivers against CAPEX tower data
The Wuxi capex driver was wrong in testing. Check capex commentary against CAPEX reporting before it goes out.
Yes — FP&A Ops, CAPEX: Validate capex drivers against CAPEX tower data.
One platform request to IT on agent limits and availability
Usage caps, blocked runs and disabled models affect every tower building agents. Raise one consolidated request.
Yes — FP&A Ops, IT, other GFS towers: One platform request to IT on agent limits and availability.
Reusable agent template for reading many files and consolidating commentary
Publish the Rhy pattern for other towers that summarise many documents, e.g. audit support packs and accrual reports.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, R2R: Reusable agent template for reading many files and consolidating commentary.
Automated SAP extraction and data massaging
Retain the completed Python extraction as the standard monthly intake and version-control the transformation logic. This removes repeated KSB1 extraction and creates a repeatable reporting input.
Unattended Python scheduling on the workday calendar
Schedule the Python run for an agreed workday such as WD+1, land the output in SharePoint, retain run logs and notify owners of failures. This removes dependency on a person starting the process.
Yes — FP&A Ops, R2R, Controlling, platform/data team: Unattended Python scheduling on the workday calendar.
Use the Manufacturing Finance Data Hub as the governed interim staging layer so in-month actuals can refresh without repeatedly running ASO, while ASO remains the final close output.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Manufacturing Finance Hub: Finance Data Hub staging layer.
Connect the dashboard mapping layer to an authoritative, more frequently refreshed master-data source so newly created cost centres are recognised without manual maintenance.
Yes — FP&A Ops, DRM/master-data owner, IT: Automated cost-centre master-data onboarding.
Standard finance mapping across sites and SAP instances
Maintain approved mappings for cost centre, management unit, function, site, wrap/rep level and comparator definitions once, then consume them consistently in Python and Power BI.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, R2R, master-data owners: Standard finance mapping across sites and SAP instances.
Power BI reconciliation between SAP and ASO
Use governed dashboard logic to compare SAP Actual and ASO Actual, highlight variances and retain drill-through evidence so users review exceptions rather than manual formulas.
Keep budget, RBU2LTP, prior-year and phased-month views in one governed dashboard to reduce separate files and improve variance explanation.
Automated refresh, reminder and completion notifications
Use a deterministic workflow to notify owners when inputs are due, refreshes complete or fail, and the monthly dashboard is ready for review.

Reviewed and aligned with further input.

Implement a Power Automate workflow that enables GFS analysts to trigger standardized stakeholder communications, including the relevant data and context, once site cost figures have been finalized for review in Power BI.
Direct commentary capture through Power Apps
Replace the Excel-based commentary source with controlled Power Apps input linked to the relevant site, period, measure and owner, improving traceability and concurrent use.
Can be implemented in the future
AI anomaly detection for first-layer review
Flag unusual variances, outliers and mapping exceptions by site, function, wrap/rep level and month so analysts can focus commentary on the highest-value movements.

Reviewed and aligned with further input.

Define differentiated thresholds for each site to reflect variations in site size and operational scale.
Allow authorised users to ask governed questions such as which function drove a manpower-cost increase or which comparator explains a variance, returning cited measures and drill paths.
Can be implemented in the future
Draft first-pass commentary from actuals, comparators, planning assumptions and validated exceptions, then route it to the responsible finance reviewer for approval.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, site finance: AI-assisted variance commentary.
Can be implemented in the future

Reviewed and aligned with futher input.

A like-for-like comparison between Actuals and Planning may be challenging with the current dataset for the following reasons:
1. Different levels of granularity: Actuals are available at the general ledger (GL) level, whereas Planning data is maintained at a higher level, such as the WRAP level.
2. Planning assumptions are not captured: The underlying assumptions used for the Planning figures are not currently stored in the dashboard, which limits the ability to explain or reconcile variances.
Document that AI can explain, summarise and validate but cannot own finance conclusions; require source citations, reviewer approval, prompt/version control and retained output history.

Reviewed and aligned with further input

The AI commentary might only be able to generate relevant decision-support insights when sufficient planning granularity and the underlying planning assumptions are available (as mentioned under FPA-12).
Power BI granularity and performance optimisation
Assess the month-phasing drill hierarchy and redesign the model so additional rep-level detail can be exposed without unacceptable dashboard performance.
Yes — FP&A Ops, data science/Power BI team, site finance: Power BI granularity and performance optimisation.
Can be implemented in the future
Create one governed extraction job pattern with approved parameters, workday scheduling, SharePoint landing, schema checks, retry and run evidence for reuse across finance reporting use cases.
Yes — FP&A Ops, R2R, Controlling, O2C, platform/data team: Shared SAP extraction service.
Reuse the site/business-unit lens, comparator selection, drill-through and reconciliation presentation pattern in future CAPEX dashboards while keeping CAPEX-specific measures and controls.
Yes — FP&A Ops, CAPEX: Dashboard design exchange with CAPEX.

However, we could only leverage selected standard Power BI page layouts as a reference, ie: SAP versus ASO data reconciliation; Standardised comparator selection.
Map current SAP and ASO fields, transformations and calculations to future S/4 data products, identifying what will be retained, replaced or temporarily bridged.
Yes — FP&A Ops, O2C, ERP/data team: S/4 transition data contract.
Can be implemented in the future
Shared run calendar, backup ownership and support model
Use one workday calendar, primary/backup ownership, capacity monitoring and failure alerts so the monthly process does not depend on one PIC and technical support can engage quickly.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Controlling, R2R, data science/platform team: Shared run calendar, backup ownership and support model.
Suggest department, site and wrap mappings for new cost centres from approved historical patterns, with a master-data owner approving every mapping.
Yes — FP&A Ops, DRM/master-data owner: AI-assisted cost-centre mapping recommendation.
Automated local-currency and USD bridge validation
Validate exchange-rate version, conversion logic and site totals across local-currency and USD views before the dashboard refresh completes.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Treasury, Controlling: Automated local-currency and USD bridge validation.
Capture planning assumptions and approved allocation rules so actual GL detail can be compared consistently with higher-level planning data.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Planning, site finance: Planning-assumption ingestion and granularity bridge.
Summarise failed reconciliations and trace likely causes to source, mapping, timing or master-data changes for analyst review.
Yes — FP&A Ops, data platform, master-data owners: AI data-quality root-cause assistant.
Check drafted commentary against dashboard measures, comparator, period and thresholds and flag unsupported statements before publication.
Yes — FP&A Ops, Controlling: AI commentary evidence checker.
Use run history and source delays to flag refreshes likely to miss the close timetable and recommend the correct support route.
Yes — FP&A Ops, platform support: Predictive refresh-failure monitoring.

ai.title: AI opportunities 17
ai.html:
AI opportunities 17

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations · hypotheses to validate with the CAPEX team
DigitalizationCapital approval tracker by stage
Process · Capital Project Approval & Set-up · Review and Approve Capital Projects · CAPEX-01.1 - Claude recommendation

Power BI view of proposals by stage (drafted, CAB review, DOA in CAS, code requested, code created) with ageing per stage, so the Business and Local Finance see where approvals sit instead of asking by email.

AutomationCAS-to-SAP project set-up in one flow
Process · Capital Project Approval & Set-up · Create Project Account Codes · CAPEX-01.2 - Claude recommendation

Approval in CAS triggers the WBSE and budget template for DMT, the automated CAS-vs-SAP validation for Local Finance and the CAS update with the new code - one tracked flow instead of five handoffs by email.

DigitalizationAUC ageing and capitalisation backlog dashboard
Key process · Project Spend, Settlement & Capitalisation · CAPEX-02 - Claude recommendation

Power BI on AUC balances by project and age with the capitalisation and closure status, so long-outstanding AUC is capitalised or impaired on time; the same view gives FP&A the actual capex spend vs plan the register proposes as a link.

AutomationProject spend exception monitoring
Process · Project Spend, Settlement & Capitalisation · Record Project Related Transactions · CAPEX-02.1 - Claude recommendation

Scheduled script over the monthly CJI3 postings flags out-of-scope spend, over-budget WBSEs and settlement-rule gaps before the settlement run; Local Finance and CAPEX work the exceptions in one list.

DigitalizationClosure-candidate detection and capitalisation checklist
Process · Project Spend, Settlement & Capitalisation · Close and Capitalise Projects · CAPEX-02.2 - Claude recommendation

Rule-based closure candidates from CN41N / AR02 plus an auto-populated commitment checklist (open PO, T&E, CATS) so projects are capitalised when complete rather than when noticed.

AutomationAsset request to asset code workflow
Process · Fixed Asset Additions · Process and Record Fixed Asset Additions - Commercial · CAPEX-03.1 - Claude recommendation

Power Apps request with CAS approval check, AS01 upload for DMT, automatic notification and tag request, monthly unposted-asset follow-up with a response tracker.

AutomationDepreciation run control tower
Process · Depreciation & Amortisation · Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense · CAPEX-05.1 - Claude recommendation

Scheduled test run, classified error list with owners, automated variance check with thresholds, Copilot-drafted explanations, go / no-go and scheduled production run - with run status per company code in Power BI.

DigitalizationImpairment indicator screening
Process · Impairments, Retirements & Transfers · Process and Record Fixed Asset Impairments · CAPEX-06.1 - Claude recommendation

Candidate list for the annual impairment review built from asset movement, cost centre status, cancelled projects and physical verification results, with the accounting treatment proposed per candidate for Local Finance to confirm.

AutomationRetirement and transfer request workflow with DOA routing
Process · Impairments, Retirements & Transfers · Process and Record Fixed Asset Retirements · CAPEX-06.2 - Claude recommendation

Form pre-filled from AS03, route determined by rule (transfer within entity, class change, between entities, decommission, sale), DOA approvals and the DMT / CAPEX actions tracked in one record.

DigitalizationDigital physical verification
Process · Physical Asset Verification · Track Fixed Assets including Physical Inventory · CAPEX-07.1 - Claude recommendation

Asset lists generated per point of contact, mobile verification form with barcode scan, automatic reminders and a Power BI status view that feeds DMT master data updates and the impairment review.

DigitalizationLease cycle status board (WD-8 to WD-1)
Key process · Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · CAPEX-08 - Claude recommendation

Power BI status of the lease cycle per entity: DCTs received, ETL uploads, records pending review, open alerts, journals exported and BlackLine acknowledgement - so the Global Lease Team and Local Finance see the critical path to WD-1 journals.

DigitalizationValidated lease data collection
Process · Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute mass lease accounting additions or modifications · CAPEX-08.1 - Claude recommendation

Data Collection Template validated against SAP master data at entry and mapped to the ETL template by script, removing most ETL upload errors and the master data loop (8.3.3.16).

AutomationLease alert triage and journal reconciliation
Process · Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Process lease accounting entries · CAPEX-08.4 - Claude recommendation

CoStar alerts classified and pre-assigned, standard dismissals batched, and journal exports reconciled to the roll-forward before BlackLine transmission.

DigitalizationLease self-service reporting
Process · Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute lease accounting reporting · CAPEX-08.6 - Claude recommendation

Scheduled CoStar reports published in Power BI for non-licensed users, with a request form and report catalogue for genuine ad hoc needs.

DigitalizationFA and lease month-end pack in Power BI
Key process · FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · CAPEX-09 - Claude recommendation

MOT files, CN comparison, reconciliations and project / FA reports from one data layer, with the ad hoc FA and lease views self-served; review time moves from building files to explaining movements.

AutomationOne month-end data layer for FA and lease reporting
Process · FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare FA ERH MOT file · CAPEX-09.1 - Claude recommendation

A single scheduled extract set (SAP asset history, GL, CoStar roll-forward) feeds the FA and lease MOT files, the CN group vs local file, the BlackLine schedules and the Power BI month-end pack - built once, reviewed by CAPEX, delivered by WD-2 / WD+4.

Process ImprovementWrite SOPs for the month-end reporting activities
Process · FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare and review month-end project and FA reports · CAPEX-09.5 - Claude recommendation

The six month-end activities in this key process have no SOP (they come from the challenges file). Documenting them - inputs, extracts, mapping rules, review and deadlines - is the prerequisite for automating them and for cover during absence.

Populate ETL templates with required…ETL templates generated from the Data Collection Template by a mapping script (no re-keying) and validated against the CoStar field rules before upload.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute mass lease accounting additions or modifications

Validated lease data collectionData Collection Template validated against SAP master data at entry and mapped to the ETL template by script, removing most ETL upload errors and the master data loop (8.3.3.16).
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Update lease accounting master data · step 1

Request master data details from in Country…Master data requests raised automatically from the ETL error log to Local Finance with the missing cost centre / internal order named; with the validated DCT this loop becomes the exception.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Approve and review a lease accounting record · step 1

Review record for accuracy and completenessAutomated completeness and attribute checks (term, payments, discount rate, classification, entity) on new or modified CoStar records exported daily; Local Finance reviews the exception list for SOX and top-80% liability entities.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Approve and review a lease accounting record · step 2
Review record for accuracy and completenessThe same automated checks give the Global Lease Team the exception list for non-SOX / non-top-80% entities, so the review is of exceptions only.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Process lease accounting entries · step 1

Review Lease Alerts pageLease alert triage: alerts exported from CoStar are classified (system error vs data audit) and pre-assigned a reason by script, with standard valid-reason dismissals batched and remediation cases routed to the owner.
Python, CoStar alerts export, Power Automate
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Process lease accounting entries · step 5

Export Journal entriesJournal export by grouping (AstraZeneca ECC and the other portfolios) scripted with a reconciliation of journal totals to the CoStar roll-forward before transmission to BlackLine.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Process lease accounting entries
Lease alert triage and journal reconciliationCoStar alerts classified and pre-assigned, standard dismissals batched, and journal exports reconciled to the roll-forward before BlackLine transmission.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Prepare lease accounting entries - BlackLine · step 2

Build lease accounting journalsTransmission and journal-build acknowledgements from the sFTP / GlobalScape and BlackLine steps monitored automatically, with an alert to the Global Lease Team on failure or missing file by WD-1.
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute lease accounting reporting · step 1

Document request and submit to CoStar userStandard lease reports scheduled from CoStar and published to Power BI for users without a licence; only ad hoc reports go to a licensed user through a request form with the report catalogue.
CoStar scheduled reports, Power BI, Power Apps form
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute lease accounting reporting
Lease self-service reportingScheduled CoStar reports published in Power BI for non-licensed users, with a request form and report catalogue for genuine ad hoc needs.

Lease cycle status board (WD-8 to WD-1)Power BI status of the lease cycle per entity: DCTs received, ETL uploads, records pending review, open alerts, journals exported and BlackLine acknowledgement - so the Global Lease Team and Local Finance see the critical path to WD-1 journals.
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare FA ERH MOT file · step 1

Prepare FA ERH MOT fileFA ERH MOT file built by script from the SAP asset history sheet and FA sub-ledger extracts mapped to the ERH movement types (additions, disposals, transfers, depreciation, impairment); CAPEX reviews the reconciliation to the GL before submission.
Python, SAP asset history / AR02 extracts, Excel output
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare FA ERH MOT file

One month-end data layer for FA and lease reportingA single scheduled extract set (SAP asset history, GL, CoStar roll-forward) feeds the FA and lease MOT files, the CN group vs local file, the BlackLine schedules and the Power BI month-end pack - built once, reviewed by CAPEX, delivered by WD-2 / WD+4.
Register GFA-01 / 02 / 23 (Feasible): scheduled SAP extraction and SharePoint transport already run via the FC&CG framework - extend the same layer to the MOT, CN and BlackLine files.
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare lease ERH MOT file · step 1

Prepare lease ERH MOT fileLease ERH MOT file from the SAP GL extract joined to the CoStar roll-forward by script, with movement rules (additions, modifications, terminations, interest, payments) coded once and exceptions listed for review.
Python, SAP GL extract, CoStar roll-forward
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare FA and lease BS reconciliations · step 1

Prepare FA and lease BS reconciliationsBlackLine auto-certification rules for zero-difference FA and lease accounts; supporting schedules (ROU assets, accumulated depreciation, lease liabilities, lease clearing) loaded through the BlackLine import template from the same extracts as the MOT files.
BlackLine auto-certification and import templates, Python
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare and review month-end project and FA reports · step 1

Prepare and review month-end project and FA…Month-end project and FA reports published as a Power BI pack from the settlement and depreciation extracts; Local Finance reviews in Power BI with sign-off captured by Power Automate.
Register GFA-03 automated consolidation and GFA-04 dashboard are tagged Not Feasible (comments: No).
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare and review month-end project and FA reports

Write SOPs for the month-end reporting activitiesThe six month-end activities in this key process have no SOP (they come from the challenges file). Documenting them - inputs, extracts, mapping rules, review and deadlines - is the prerequisite for automating them and for cover during absence.
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Respond to ad hoc FA and lease queries · step 1

Respond to ad hoc FA and lease queriesGlobal FA and lease self-service view in Power BI (by entity, asset class, lease portfolio, movement) answers most ad hoc requests; remaining queries logged in a tracker to feed the standard views.
Register GFA-05 raw data download for local finance and GFA-08 AI self-service assistant are Feasible; GFA-04 dashboard is Not Feasible.

FA and lease month-end pack in Power BIMOT files, CN comparison, reconciliations and project / FA reports from one data layer, with the ad hoc FA and lease views self-served; review time moves from building files to explaining movements.
Register GFA-04 self-service Power BI dashboard is tagged Not Feasible (comments: No); GFA-25 / 24 entity and country views are Feasible.
Capital Project Approval & Set-up · Review and Approve Capital Projects · step 1
Copilot in Word / ExcelCopilot drafts the business case narrative (benefits, costs, savings, vendors, term) from the proposal inputs for the Business to complete.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Capital Project Approval & Set-up · Review and Approve Capital Projects · step 2

Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the capital policy and the DOA pre-checks the proposal for completeness and flags the policy gaps before the Capital Approval Board review.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Capital Project Approval & Set-up · Create Project Account Codes · step 1
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the WBSE creation confirmation and the budget upload request from the approved CAS record.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Project Spend, Settlement & Capitalisation · Record Project Related Transactions · step 2
Copilot in ExcelCopilot summarises the postings against the project budget and flags the unusual lines for Local Finance to review.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Project Spend, Settlement & Capitalisation · Close and Capitalise Projects · step 2
Copilot in Excel / Power BICopilot drafts the project closure review summary (spend vs approval, open items) from the expenditure report.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Fixed Asset Additions · Process and Record Fixed Asset Additions - Commercial · step 1

Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An asset request assistant grounded on the fixed asset policy answers asset class, capitalisation threshold and useful life questions and checks the request before it is sent.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Depreciation & Amortisation · Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense · step 3
Copilot Studio agentAn agent classifies the AFAB / AFBP errors from the Capper Bot output (missing depreciation key, incomplete asset, locked cost centre) and drafts the resolution note to the owner.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Depreciation & Amortisation · Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense · step 4
Copilot in ExcelCopilot drafts the depreciation variance commentary against the prior month from the posting extract, for CAPEX to review.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Impairments, Retirements & Transfers · Process and Record Fixed Asset Impairments · step 1
Copilot in ExcelCopilot summarises the impairment indicators per asset from the review extract and drafts the review note.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Impairments, Retirements & Transfers · Process and Record Fixed Asset Retirements · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent checks the retirement form against the DOA approvals, the net book value and the required documents and lists the gaps for the requester.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Physical Asset Verification · Track Fixed Assets including Physical Inventory · step 4
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the escalation note for the non-responding points of contact from the Power Apps tracker status.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute mass lease accounting additions or modifications · step 1
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the lease accounting SOP checks the Data Collection Template for missing or inconsistent fields before the ETL upload.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Approve and review a lease accounting record · step 1
Copilot in ExcelCopilot compares the lease record against the contract summary and lists the differences for the reviewer.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Lease Accounting (IFRS 16) · Execute lease accounting reporting · step 2
Copilot in ExcelCopilot drafts the CoStar report specification (parameters, columns, filters) from the request for the licensed user.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Prepare and review month-end project and FA reports · step 1
Copilot in Power BI / ExcelCopilot drafts the month-end project and FA report commentary (movements, open items) for CAPEX and Local Finance to review.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
FA & Lease Month-End Reporting · Respond to ad hoc FA and lease queries · step 1
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the FA and lease SOPs answers the first-line queries from Local Finance and drafts the reply for CAPEX to confirm.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed

Related TPIs · Global Fixed Assets dashboard (TPI Aug 2026) 35

CAPEX_Feasibility_Register.xlsx, columns as in the workbook · Feasibility / Relevance Status filled from the comments: Feasible · 18 Not Feasible · 5 Under review · 12
Opportunity IDOpportunityPractical Action & Stakeholder ValuePrimary CategoryAutomationAIFeasibility & Cross Collaboration CommentsSource / Review StatusFeasibility / Relevance StatusRemarks / Comments
GFA-01Scheduled SAP extraction via the FC&CG automation frameworkReplace manual extraction across six SAP instances with the scheduled automation framework already built by FC&CG.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, FC&CG: Scheduled SAP extraction via the FC&CG automation framework.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-02Automated HTML conversion and SharePoint transportThe HTML extract, conversion to Excel and transfer to the R2R SharePoint already run on a schedule.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, FC&CG: Automated HTML conversion and SharePoint transport.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-03Automated regional and global consolidationOne governed consolidation replaces seven or more Excel files merged by hand every cycle.AutomationYesNoNoRaised in session / project materialNot Feasible—
GFA-04Self-service Power BI dashboard with statutory and management viewsSix to seven pages giving stakeholders filtering and drill-down without an FA team request.AutomationYesNoNoRaised in session / project materialNot Feasible—
GFA-05Raw data download from the dashboardLocal finance needs its own entity numbers, not the global view. Let them export directly.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, local finance: Raw data download from the dashboard.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-06Move the data source to Snowflake once validatedSnowflake is the strategic source. Permissions and data validation are the two outstanding conditions.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, Global Digital: Move the data source to Snowflake once validated.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-07Adopt AWS QuickSuite on Snowflake as the enterprise AI layerThe enterprise equivalent of Copilot, connected to Snowflake, with more interactive querying.AIYesYesYes — Global Digital, R2R: Adopt AWS QuickSuite on Snowflake as the enterprise AI layer.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-08Embed an AI self-service assistant in the dashboardStakeholders ask questions on AUC and fixed asset data and get answers without FA team support.AIYesYesYes — R2R, Global Digital: Embed an AI self-service assistant in the dashboard.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-09Extend extraction to S/4HANA and Alexion entitiesCurrent automation covers SAP ECC only. Migrated and Alexion entities are the remaining coverage gap.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, FC&CG: Extend extraction to S/4HANA and Alexion entities.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-10Use Jupyter Notebook as an interim analytical solutionA tactical route for forecasting and analysis while the strategic AI stack is being settled.AINoYesNoRaised in session / project materialNot Feasible—
GFA-11Rule out Copilot in Power BITested and found to misread context and return wrong numbers; not part of the enterprise AI roadmap.Process ImprovementNoYesYes — R2R, Global Digital: Rule out Copilot in Power BI.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-12Replace the HTML-to-Excel conversion chain with a direct extractCSV loses formatting so HTML is used and converted. A direct extract to a governed store removes the step and the India-team dependency.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, FC&CG, IT: Replace the HTML-to-Excel conversion chain with a direct extract.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-13Automated data quality validation on every loadRow counts and control totals checked against SAP on each refresh. This is what would make Snowflake trusted.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, Global Digital: Automated data quality validation on every load.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-14Incremental loading and pre-aggregation for scaleAbout 300,000 rows for June alone. Incremental refresh keeps performance stable as full history is loaded.AutomationYesNoNoAI-suggested — To be reviewedNot Feasible—
GFA-15Anomaly detection on asset movementsFlag unusual additions, disposals, transfers and impairments month on month before anyone reads the dashboard.AIYesYesYes — R2R, Controlling: Anomaly detection on asset movements.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-16Automated month-on-month variance commentaryGenerate a first-draft explanation of movements for the FA team to review, rather than writing it each cycle.AIYesYesNoAI-suggested — To be reviewedNot Feasible—
GFA-17Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation dataAR03 depreciation simulation is already identified as a needed extract. Surfacing forward depreciation answers the end-of-life question raised in session.AIYesYesYes — R2R, Controlling: Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation data.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-18Ground the assistant on a governed semantic modelA retrieval-based assistant over a defined semantic layer avoids both the Copilot context problem and external-model privacy exposure.AIYesYesYes — R2R, Global Digital: Ground the assistant on a governed semantic model.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-19Retire the annual Operations request entirelyOnce the pilot proves out, generate the Operations pack from the dashboard rather than servicing the request each year.AutomationYesNoYes — R2R, Global Operations: Retire the annual Operations request entirely.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-20Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboardThe GPO is developing a comparable higher-level dashboard sourced from Snowflake. Overlap is known and acknowledged.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — GPO, R2R: Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboard.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-21Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building furtherA Financial Analytics Council global fixed asset dashboard already provides depreciation and management information.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — R2R, Global Digital, GPO: Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building further.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-22Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into SnowflakeGet the outstanding tables onto the platform so the strategic route becomes viable.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — GPO, GPDD, R2R: Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into Snowflake.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-23Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation frameworkRather than building a separate extraction, use the framework FC&CG already offers. Already engaged.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — FC&CG, R2R: Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-24Add a country-level view alongside management unitMarkets need to answer how much capital was invested in their country. Supports government and agency engagement.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — R2R, LT, market finance: Add a country-level view alongside management unit.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-25Consider an entity view in place of management unitManagement unit requires a mapping against DRM data that must be refreshed. An entity view removes one mapping dependency.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — Controlling, R2R: Consider an entity view in place of management unit.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-26Consider a budget versus capitalised actual viewControlling reviews budget against market requests, and some markets maintain budget in SAP.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — Controlling, R2R: Consider a budget versus capitalised actual view.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-27Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation viewNot all assets share the same life. Leadership asked for visibility of when depreciation ends.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — R2R, Controlling: Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation view.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-28Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pagesAgreed in session: a short workstream with Controlling and leadership to decide what else the dashboard should carry.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — R2R, Controlling, LT: Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pages.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-29Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboardUtilisation against approved CapEx may already exist. Give them the idea rather than rebuilding it.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — Global Operations, R2R: Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboard.Raised in session / project materialFeasible—
GFA-30Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projectsFixed assets, BSR automation and non-PO accrual are all waiting on the same platform. One roadmap serves all three.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — Global Digital, R2R, P2P: Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projects.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-31Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboardsCopilot has now been tested independently by more than one team. One decision, published, stops the repetition.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoYesYes — Global Digital, all towers: Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-32Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towersThe same scheduled SAP extraction pattern serves R2R, P2P and Controlling. Build it once as a shared service.Cross-Tower CollaborationYesNoYes — FC&CG, R2R, P2P, Controlling: Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towers.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-33Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local financeStandardise the reporting view before the pages are fixed, so the dashboard is not redesigned after launch.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoNoYes — R2R, Controlling, local finance: Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local finance.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-34Set a central data-privacy position on external AI modelsThe privacy question that blocks better models is not a project decision. It needs an owned, published position.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoYesYes — Global Digital, Legal, Controllership: Set a central data-privacy position on external AI models.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—
GFA-35Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboardsAn AI assistant only works on a standardised semantic layer. Setting the standard once makes every tower's dashboard AI-ready.Cross-Tower CollaborationNoYesYes — Global Digital, all towers: Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboards.AI-suggested — To be reviewedUnder review—

Tag rule. Comments "No" → Not Feasible · comments "Yes — teams" and raised in session / project material → Feasible · comments "Yes" but Source / Review Status "AI-suggested — To be reviewed" → Under review. The same tag is written into the workbook's Feasibility / Relevance Status column.
