rows: Scheduled SAP extraction via the FC&CG automation framework
Replace manual extraction across six SAP instances with the scheduled automation framework already built by FC&CG.
Yes — R2R, FC&CG: Scheduled SAP extraction via the FC&CG automation framework.
Automated HTML conversion and SharePoint transport
The HTML extract, conversion to Excel and transfer to the R2R SharePoint already run on a schedule.
Yes — R2R, FC&CG: Automated HTML conversion and SharePoint transport.
One governed consolidation replaces seven or more Excel files merged by hand every cycle.
Self-service Power BI dashboard with statutory and management views
Six to seven pages giving stakeholders filtering and drill-down without an FA team request.
Raw data download from the dashboard
Local finance needs its own entity numbers, not the global view. Let them export directly.
Yes — R2R, local finance: Raw data download from the dashboard.
Move the data source to Snowflake once validated
Snowflake is the strategic source. Permissions and data validation are the two outstanding conditions.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Move the data source to Snowflake once validated.
Adopt AWS QuickSuite on Snowflake as the enterprise AI layer
The enterprise equivalent of Copilot, connected to Snowflake, with more interactive querying.
Yes — Global Digital, R2R: Adopt AWS QuickSuite on Snowflake as the enterprise AI layer.
Embed an AI self-service assistant in the dashboard
Stakeholders ask questions on AUC and fixed asset data and get answers without FA team support.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Embed an AI self-service assistant in the dashboard.
Extend extraction to S/4HANA and Alexion entities
Current automation covers SAP ECC only. Migrated and Alexion entities are the remaining coverage gap.
Yes — R2R, FC&CG: Extend extraction to S/4HANA and Alexion entities.
Use Jupyter Notebook as an interim analytical solution
A tactical route for forecasting and analysis while the strategic AI stack is being settled.
Rule out Copilot in Power BI
Tested and found to misread context and return wrong numbers; not part of the enterprise AI roadmap.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Rule out Copilot in Power BI.
Replace the HTML-to-Excel conversion chain with a direct extract
CSV loses formatting so HTML is used and converted. A direct extract to a governed store removes the step and the India-team dependency.
Yes — R2R, FC&CG, IT: Replace the HTML-to-Excel conversion chain with a direct extract.
Automated data quality validation on every load
Row counts and control totals checked against SAP on each refresh. This is what would make Snowflake trusted.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Automated data quality validation on every load.
Incremental loading and pre-aggregation for scale
About 300,000 rows for June alone. Incremental refresh keeps performance stable as full history is loaded.
Flag unusual additions, disposals, transfers and impairments month on month before anyone reads the dashboard.
Yes — R2R, Controlling: Anomaly detection on asset movements.
Generate a first-draft explanation of movements for the FA team to review, rather than writing it each cycle.
Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation data
AR03 depreciation simulation is already identified as a needed extract. Surfacing forward depreciation answers the end-of-life question raised in session.
Yes — R2R, Controlling: Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation data.
Ground the assistant on a governed semantic model
A retrieval-based assistant over a defined semantic layer avoids both the Copilot context problem and external-model privacy exposure.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Ground the assistant on a governed semantic model.
Retire the annual Operations request entirely
Once the pilot proves out, generate the Operations pack from the dashboard rather than servicing the request each year.
Yes — R2R, Global Operations: Retire the annual Operations request entirely.
Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboard
The GPO is developing a comparable higher-level dashboard sourced from Snowflake. Overlap is known and acknowledged.
Yes — GPO, R2R: Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboard.
Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building further
A Financial Analytics Council global fixed asset dashboard already provides depreciation and management information.
Yes — R2R, Global Digital, GPO: Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building further.
Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into Snowflake
Get the outstanding tables onto the platform so the strategic route becomes viable.
Yes — GPO, GPDD, R2R: Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into Snowflake.
Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework
Rather than building a separate extraction, use the framework FC&CG already offers. Already engaged.
Yes — FC&CG, R2R: Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework.
Add a country-level view alongside management unit
Markets need to answer how much capital was invested in their country. Supports government and agency engagement.
Yes — R2R, LT, market finance: Add a country-level view alongside management unit.
Consider an entity view in place of management unit
Management unit requires a mapping against DRM data that must be refreshed. An entity view removes one mapping dependency.
Yes — Controlling, R2R: Consider an entity view in place of management unit.
Consider a budget versus capitalised actual view
Controlling reviews budget against market requests, and some markets maintain budget in SAP.
Yes — Controlling, R2R: Consider a budget versus capitalised actual view.
Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation view
Not all assets share the same life. Leadership asked for visibility of when depreciation ends.
Yes — R2R, Controlling: Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation view.
Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pages
Agreed in session: a short workstream with Controlling and leadership to decide what else the dashboard should carry.
Yes — R2R, Controlling, LT: Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pages.
Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboard
Utilisation against approved CapEx may already exist. Give them the idea rather than rebuilding it.
Yes — Global Operations, R2R: Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboard.
Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projects
Fixed assets, BSR automation and non-PO accrual are all waiting on the same platform. One roadmap serves all three.
Yes — Global Digital, R2R, P2P: Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projects.
Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards
Copilot has now been tested independently by more than one team. One decision, published, stops the repetition.
Yes — Global Digital, all towers: Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards.
Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towers
The same scheduled SAP extraction pattern serves R2R, P2P and Controlling. Build it once as a shared service.
Yes — FC&CG, R2R, P2P, Controlling: Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towers.
Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local finance
Standardise the reporting view before the pages are fixed, so the dashboard is not redesigned after launch.
Yes — R2R, Controlling, local finance: Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local finance.
Set a central data-privacy position on external AI models
The privacy question that blocks better models is not a project decision. It needs an owned, published position.
Yes — Global Digital, Legal, Controllership: Set a central data-privacy position on external AI models.
Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboards
An AI assistant only works on a standardised semantic layer. Setting the standard once makes every tower's dashboard AI-ready.
Yes — Global Digital, all towers: Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboards.

asIs.title: P2P As-Is Process Map
asIs.html:
Procure to Pay · Goods & services receipt → Invoice management → Payment → Month-end close · specialist variants on the side · 5 key processes, 20 flows · final review 16 Oct 2026

P2P As-Is Process Map

How AstraZeneca makes sure we only pay suppliers for goods and services that were ordered, received, correctly invoiced, approved and paid: the purchase order, the goods receipt and the invoice are matched in Coupa, variances are approved by the business, the liability is recorded in SAP and the payment run pays the supplier on the due date. Everything else is an exception branch or a specialist variant. Updated for the final review with Ching Yee Thow and Emily Lau (16 Oct 2026).

All documented pain points · AI suggestion to resolve · feasibility tag and comment from the final review of 16 Oct 2026

1Goods & services receiptGoods / service receipt · step 3Delays in posting goods receipts hurt Payment to Terms and Invoice Turnaround TimeGR nudge agent and pre-filled receipt (Goods receipt · step 3); automated GR chaser on the missing-receipt exception (Flow 2 · step 2a)Can be exploredAutomated reminder emails for pending receipts are already in place; pre-filling or performing the receipt is not - the requester must still confirm the physical receipt (control). Under exploration by the global P2P team.
2Invoice managementFlow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 3Unstructured data makes Kofax line-item matching difficultLLM line-item extraction and semantic PO-line matching on top of Kofax (Flow 1 · step 3), with confidence-based exception review (step 4)Can be exploredOCR extraction is in place; the LLM layer to match line items by meaning (low-confidence cases routed to AP) is the new part - to be explored.
3Invoice managementFlow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2aGR delays leave invoices stuck in Pending receiptAutomated GR chaser with escalation (Flow 2 · step 2a) and GR nudge at receipt (Goods receipt · step 3)Already implementedCoupa notifications and the team script already chase missing receipts; the global P2P receipt initiative covers the rest.
4Invoice managementFlow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1Tolerance inconsistency Coupa vs SAP Direct MaterialsHarmonised Coupa / SAP tolerance master and variance summary for approvers (Flow 3 · step 1)Can be exploredNice to have, low impact. The Coupa / SAP over-delivery tolerance difference is a known S/4 issue, not a separate AI solution.

ai.title: AI opportunities 11
ai.html:
AI opportunities 11

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations with the feasibility tag from the final review
AutomationGR ageing monitor and nudge agent
Process · Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receipt · AI-suggested · Already implemented

Monitor POs with invoices waiting in Pending receipt, nudge the requisitioner and escalate by ageing; report GR lead time by market against the P2P KPIs (Payment to Terms, Invoice TAT).

Review: The GR reminder is already in place (Coupa notifications, email reminders, team script); the global P2P team is exploring the receipt-related AI use cases.

AITouchless capture for unstructured invoices
Process · Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · AI-suggested · Can be explored

LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of Kofax with confidence-based routing; target: most PDF and email invoices reach Coupa with no AP touch.

Review: LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of the existing OCR - to be explored; Kofax itself is being replaced by a new global tool.

AIException-resolution agent for Coupa holds
Process · Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · AI-suggested · Already implemented

One agent works the Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold and Pending receipt queues: proposes the fix, chases the right person and releases within policy; AP supervises by exception.

Review: Covered by the global non-PO project (just live), the existing Coupa notifications and the Coupa variance threshold.

AutomationPosting-error auto-remediation
Process · Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · AI-suggested · Already implemented

Classify Coupa-to-SAP posting errors, auto-apply the known fix and re-push, and feed error patterns back to DMT master-data quality.

Review: SAP posting error messages are part of the existing design; AP investigates from the message.

AutomationPayment-failure triage
Process · Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · AI-suggested · Already implemented

Classify payment-run failures, pre-fill the manual payment request and track the vendor clearing (F-44) so the exception closes without re-keying.

Review: Payment-failure handling sits with Cash & Banking (PSPC initiative) - to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.

AutomationStraight-through early payment requests
Process · Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · AI-suggested · Can be explored

Policy-based auto-approval, approval matrix from the DOA master and automated payment-date change in SAP.

Review: Low impact; the approval matrix part is not relevant, the SAP days update can be explored.

Process ImprovementOne accrual ownership model across P2P, R2R, Controlling and FP&A Ops
Key process · Month-end close · NPO-19 to NPO-23, NPO-27 to NPO-30 · Under assessment

Agree who accrues what (pending approval vs approved-not-posted vs ad hoc vs departmental), close the Coupa AP vs Coupa P2P scope question, bring Controlling and FP&A Ops into the design, revisit the non-PO guideline as the root lever and take the continue / stop decision to local finance with the data.

Review: TPI NPO-19 / 20 / 21 / 27: accrual ownership across the towers.

AutomationSystem-generated non-PO accruals (target Q1 2027)
Process · Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · NPO-08, NPO-29, NPO-30 · Under assessment

Once the common global framework and RACI are agreed (Nov-Dec 2026), accruals are generated by the system from Coupa / Celonis data with controller review; the Python asset is the bridge until then.

Review: TPI NPO-08: system-generated accruals from Q1 2027 once the framework and RACI are agreed.

AIControl execution assistant
Process · Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · AI-suggested · Not relevant

Runs the SOP-defined checks over scheduled extracts, drafts the control result and packages system-generated evidence for OneGRC.

Review: Control execution needs human validation.

AutomationShared automation platform for all towers
Process · Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · BSR-21 to BSR-23, BSR-27, BSR-29 to BSR-31, BSR-35 · Can be explored

The VM, repository, governance, run dashboard, coverage inventory and training pack built for P2P BSR serve O2C, Controlling and Tax too (BSR-30 feasible; BSR-31, BSR-34, BSR-35); align with the R2R-led global BSR programme and adopt what R2R has built (BSR-21, BSR-22), with GPO / GPDD endorsement (BSR-23), Genpact (BSR-27) and named regional owners (BSR-29).

Review: TPI BSR-30 / 31 / 32 / 35: the framework offered to all towers - feasible per the register.

AutomationDown payment straight-through
Process · Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · AI-suggested · Can be explored

Approved form posts the down payment, the payment run pays it and the final invoice clears it - AP confirms partial clearings only.

Review: Coupa (Others) down payment straight-through needs a bot / integration; China already auto-posts via iPay.

BSR-31, BSR-34, BSR-35); align with the R2R-led global BSR programme and adopt what R2R has built (BSR-21, BSR-22), with GPO / GPDD endorsement (BSR-23), Genpact (BSR-27) and named regional owners (BSR-29).Review: TPI BSR-30 / 31 / 32 / 35: the framework offered to all towers - feasible per the register.AutomationDown payment straight-throughProcess · Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · AI-suggested · Can be exploredApproved form posts the down payment, the payment run pays it and the final invoice clears it - AP confirms partial clearings only.Review: Coupa (Others) down payment straight-through needs a bot / integration; ai.title: AI solution register 61
ai.html:
AI solution register 61

Every suggested step change, Copilot / Agent Builder option and AI opportunity · feasibility tag and comment from the final review of 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau) · decisions on solutioning and prioritisation sit with the GPO / GPDT
#WhereKindSuggestionToolsActivity type
As-Is → if adopted		FeasibilityRegister / LT comments
1Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receipt · step 3Step changePost the receipt - GR nudge and pre-filled receipt
Celonis / Coupa flags invoices waiting in Pending receipt and nudges the requisitioner automatically (Teams / email, escalating by ageing to the line manager). The receipt is pre-filled from the PO line and the delivery note so the receiver only confirms the quantity.		Celonis action flow or Coupa notification; Power Automate / Teams; delivery-note OCR (Kofax)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAutomated reminder emails for pending receipts are already in place; pre-filling or performing the receipt is not - the requester must still confirm the physical receipt (control). Under exploration by the global P2P team.
2Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 2Step changeRoute to the CIR mailbox / scan paper invoice
An AI mailbox triage reads the CIR mailbox: it separates invoices from other mail, lifts the accounting codes and budget-holder details the requestor supplied, and bounces invalid file types / sizes back to the sender automatically, so step 2a disappears for most cases.		LLM email classifier (Azure OpenAI / Copilot Studio); Power Automate; Kofax import connectorSemi-automated → Semi-automatedAlready implementedAlready part of the design: invoices sent to the CIR mailbox are captured by the system and generated as invoice documents into Kofax.
3Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 2aStep changeNotify the supplier to resend
Auto-reply with the accepted formats and size limit; AP only sees repeat failures.		Power Automate; mailbox rulesManual → AutomatedCan be exploredKofax may support automated notifications, but AP still manages the discarded emails; supplier details and the current configuration need to be validated.
4Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 3Step changeKofax OCR extracts and validates the invoice
Add an LLM extraction layer for unstructured invoices: line-item descriptions are matched to PO lines by meaning rather than exact text, and low-confidence fields are routed to AP (step 4) instead of failing the match.		Kofax + LLM document extraction (Azure Document Intelligence / GPT); Coupa PO line dataAutomated → AutomatedCan be exploredOCR extraction is in place; the LLM layer to match line items by meaning (low-confidence cases routed to AP) is the new part - to be explored.
5Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4Step changeAP verifies and completes the extracted data
AP reviews only the fields below the confidence threshold; high-confidence invoices pass straight to Coupa. Kofax-to-Coupa transmission is monitored on a dashboard rather than by a daily manual check.		Kofax confidence scores; Celonis / Power BI transmission monitorManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredConfidence-based review (e.g. 80% threshold for straight-through) can be explored; the transmission monitoring belongs after the export, and the Celonis dashboard already exists.
6Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4Copilot agent optionCopilot in Outlook / Kofax queue
Copilot drafts the query to the supplier or requester for the fields that could not be extracted, from the invoice image and the PO.		Copilot in Outlook / Kofax queueManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
7Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 5aStep changeRaise a ServiceNow ticket and resolve
Interface monitoring detects Kofax-Coupa failures and raises the ServiceNow incident with the invoice reference automatically; AP tracks the resolution.		Celonis / interface monitoring; ServiceNow APIManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantA ServiceNow ticket is raised only after the team validates that the integration failure is technical; automatic ticket creation is not relevant. Transmission monitoring (Celonis dashboard) is already implemented.
8Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 1aStep changeException - missing information or hold
An agent completes missing invoice details from the PO, supplier record and remit-to master, maps the remit-to address and proposes the hold release; AP approves the proposal instead of keying the data.		Coupa API; vendor master (DMT); LLM agentManual → Semi-automatedAlready implementedCovered by the global non-PO project that just went live.
9Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2aStep changeException - missing receipt
Automated GR chaser: the requestor is reminded on a schedule with the PO and invoice attached and escalated by ageing; AP steps in only when the chaser fails.		Coupa notifications; Power Automate / Teams; Celonis ageingSemi-automated → Semi-automatedAlready implementedCoupa notifications and the team script already chase missing receipts; the global P2P receipt initiative covers the rest.
10Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2bStep changeException - price variance (On Hold)
A variance assistant explains the difference (price list, contract, FX, quantity) and auto-accepts variances within policy; AP decides only the residual cases.		Coupa; contract / price-list data; LLM assistantManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantCoupa standard: price variances within the approved threshold are auto-approved and the variance assistant already states whether the PO unit price or the total is off.
11Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1Step changeApprover reviews the invoice in Coupa
The approver receives a one-paragraph variance summary (what differs from the PO, why, policy position) with a recommended action. Harmonise the over-delivery tolerance between Coupa and SAP Direct Materials so the same invoice is not blocked twice.		Coupa approval to-do + LLM summary; tolerance master alignment (Coupa / SAP)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredNice to have, low impact. The Coupa / SAP over-delivery tolerance difference is a known S/4 issue, not a separate AI solution.
12Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1Copilot agent optionCopilot in Coupa / Outlook
Copilot summarises what differs from the PO and the policy position for the approver, instead of a one-paragraph summary built into Coupa.		Copilot in Coupa / OutlookManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
13Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 2aStep changeException - SAP posting error
Posting errors are classified by type; known types (missing WHT code, blocked vendor, closed period) trigger the fix request to DMT / Ops IT and the re-push (Exported = No) automatically. AP handles only unknown errors.		Coupa-SAP error log; rules + LLM classifier; ServiceNow APIManual → Semi-automatedAlready implementedSAP already shows the posting error message; the remaining effort is AP investigation of the message - part of the existing design.
14Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2Step changeInvestigate and assess the resolution
A failure root-cause classifier (invalid characters, bank details, format, system) proposes whether a re-run or a manual payment is needed.		SAP F110 log; rules / ML classifierManual → Semi-automatedAlready implementedPayment-failure handling is covered by the Cash & Banking PSPC initiative; SAP shows the high-level failure and AP / Cash & Banking judge re-run vs manual payment. Ownership to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
15Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2Copilot agent optionCopilot in Excel / Outlook
Copilot drafts the investigation note from the SAP failure message and the vendor master, for AP and Cash & Banking to decide on re-run vs manual payment.		Copilot in Excel / OutlookManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
16Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 3Step changeReverse the payment document and raise the manual payment request
The manual payment request in CROWN is pre-filled from the SAP document (payment details, supporting documents, root cause) for the Payment Processor to confirm.		CROWN; SAP; Power AutomateManual → Semi-automatedUnder assessmentCROWN is being replaced by Cash & Banking; the pre-filled request depends on the new tool.
17Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2Step changeBlock the invoice, troubleshoot and resolve
Bank-detail and vendor-master validation (IBAN / SWIFT format, country rules) runs before the next payment run and proposes the correction to DMT.		Vendor master validation service; bank format rules; DMT request APIManual → Semi-automatedAlready implementedMDG already validates the bank details (IBAN, bank name, format) before DMT maintains them in SAP - implemented upfront, not before the payment run.
18Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2Agent Builder optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
An agent grounded on the rejection reasons and the bank-detail rules lists the likely cause and the correction for AP before the invoice is unblocked.		Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
19Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 1aStep changeBusiness and P2P Ops approval
Drive the ServiceNow approval matrix from the DOA / HR hierarchy master so it maintains itself; approvals route automatically and every change is audited.		ServiceNow; Workday / DOA master integrationManual → AutomatedNot relevantThe right procurement leaders cannot be identified from the HR hierarchy today.
20Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 2Step changeAP reviews the approvals and adjusts the payment date
Once approved, the Days field update in SAP (FB02) is applied by the workflow and the ticket closes automatically.		ServiceNow workflow; SAP RPA / BAPIManual → AutomatedCan be exploredMinimal impact; the workflow calculation of the payment days and the ownership need to be validated.
21Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 1Step changeNotification of incoming funds
Incoming funds are matched to the supplier automatically from remittance text, amount and open credits (the same ML matching pattern as O2C cash application); unmatched items are listed for AP with the best candidates.		Bank statement / Lockbox data; ML matching (BlackLine-style); SAPManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCash & Banking process - ownership of the incoming-funds posting to be confirmed with Cash & Banking (Angie) before this is taken further.
22Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 2Step changeBook the item in SAP
Matched items are posted automatically (F42 / FB01) with the proposed account; AP books only the unmatched residue.		SAP BAPI / RPAManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCash & Banking books the items it can identify; the automatic proposal would cover the unmatched residue - to confirm with Cash & Banking (Angie).
23Payment · Flow 6 - Control: duplicate payment monitoring (Xelix) · step 2Step changeAP examines each case
Extend duplicate detection to down payments (special GL items) and non-invoice payments, and use the Xelix outcome history to auto-release known false positives.		Xelix configuration; SAP special GL dataManual → Semi-automatedUnder assessmentXelix already covers down payments; the high-risk scenarios (e.g. invoice posted before the down payment) are under review.
24Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 1Step changeSet the Coupa interface cut-off in SAP
Schedule the Coupa interface cut-off from the month-end calendar (one variant per company code) instead of keying the dates.		SAP job scheduling (/n/AZGWS/COUPA_PDT2 variant)Manual → AutomatedUnder assessmentMonth-end interface cut-off scheduling is in progress.
25Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 2Step changePosting-error population moves to Coupa P2P / R2R scope
Coupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P and leave the non-PO accrual population (P2P feedback on NPO-09). Approved-but-not-posted items are accrued once, under the ownership agreed between P2P and R2R (NPO-19, NPO-20).		Coupa P2P; R2R AJD stuck-invoice accrualManual → AutomatedUnder assessmentTPI Non-PO Accrual NPO-09 / NPO-26: Coupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P.
26Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 3Step changeExtract non-PO invoices pending in Coupa (Celonis)
The Python asset already built pulls the Celonis Non PO Account Allocation extract on schedule (NPO-01); Celonis stays the data source (P2P feedback on NPO-12 / NPO-34).		Celonis Coupa Control Tower; Python scriptSemi-automated → AutomatedAlready implementedTPI NPO-01: the Python script that pulls the Celonis extract on schedule is already built.
27Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 4Step changeConsolidate and apply the exclusion criteria
The Python script consolidates the extracts and applies the exclusion logic held as versioned, machine-readable rules with an audit trail (NPO-10). Milestone-based accruals read the percentage of completion from Veeva / WorkMate (NPO-02); the country-level data crunch (NPO-07) decides which population survives the elimination decision.		Python; rules engine; Veeva / WorkMate integration; manual journal dashboard (NPO-04)Manual → AutomatedUnder assessmentTPI NPO-10 (exclusion logic as a rules engine) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
28Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 5Step changeRaise the accrual journal in BlackLine
The journal is prepared by the script and pre-validated against BlackLine master data (GL, cost centre, internal order) before import, so the re-upload loop disappears (NPO-11). Straight-through posting (NPO-17 pattern) to be reassessed with R2R for China per P2P feedback.		Python; BlackLine import / API; master-data validationManual → AutomatedUnder assessmentTPI NPO-11 (journal pre-validation against BlackLine master data) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
29Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 6Step changeChina: contribution accrual and pre-payment offsetting
Automate the China contribution accrual on WorkMate with R2R by August 2026 and handle the pre-payment offsetting inside the automation so the separate step disappears (NPO-05, NPO-06); reuse the China commitment-report dashboard already in build (NPO-03).		WorkMate; R2R posting; Controllership commitment dashboardManual → AutomatedUnder assessmentTPI NPO-05 / NPO-06: China contribution accrual automation on WorkMate with R2R.
30Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 1Step changeExtract the control reports
Control reports are extracted on schedule (SAP job scheduling / Celonis export) into the control workspace.		SAP job scheduling; Celonis; SharePointSemi-automated → AutomatedAlready implementedControl reports are already extracted with Celonis and Python.
31Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2Step changeExecute the controls per the mini-SOX SOP
A control assistant runs the mini-SOX SOP checks over the extracted reports and drafts the control result for AP to confirm; exceptions are listed with their evidence.		Python / Power Automate; LLM assistant over the SOPManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantControl execution needs human validation of the exceptions.
32Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2Agent Builder optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
An agent grounded on the mini-SOX SOP walks the control steps and drafts the control result for the preparer to validate - the exceptions stay with AP.		Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
33Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 3Step changeSubmit the control file and evidence in OneGRC
System-generated evidence (record counts, run manifest, time-stamped extracts) replaces screenshots and is uploaded to OneGRC by workflow.		OneGRC upload; run manifestsManual → Semi-automatedAlready implementedEvidence extraction is automated with Python; the scripts can still fail when line items exceed the predefined rules - to be raised with the COE Digital team.
34Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 1Step changeUpdate the GL checklist
The GL checklist is driven from the BlackLine and GL master (BSR-13 - future; companies not on BlackLine still to be understood) and carries the company code + GL account list, so onboarding an entity is a data change, not a code change (BSR-19 - feasible).		BlackLine / GL master; GL checklist file as configurationManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-13 / BSR-19: GL checklist driven from the BlackLine / GL master; configuration-driven company-code onboarding raised in the retro.
35Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 2Step changeExtract the SAP balance and open-item reports
SAP job scheduling runs the extraction server-side on predefined variants, removing individual SAP access and the screen-coordinate dependency (BSR-02, BSR-11 - feasible). One shared extraction service can serve BSR, non-PO accrual and other towers if the templates align (BSR-32). Reading from Snowflake is not pursued (BSR-14 feedback); what already sits there is to be assessed (BSR-28).		SAP job scheduling; shared extraction serviceSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-02 / BSR-11: SAP job scheduling replaces GUI extraction - raised in session.
36Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3Step changePrepare the reconciliation from the entity template
One common automation framework on a standardised BlackLine template (BSR-01, BSR-03) runs on a centralised, governed VM (BSR-04; request via DevOps, BSR-25) with scheduling, logging and alerting (BSR-05), version control (BSR-06) and a central SharePoint repository (BSR-08); coverage extends to the remaining 582 GL account assignments (BSR-07) and the design anticipates Axial / S/4HANA (BSR-10).		Python framework; central VM; SharePoint repositorySemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-01 / 03 / 04-08: common template and framework on a centralised VM - raised in session.
37Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3aStep changeFix or rerun the script; prepare manually
A central Power BI run dashboard shows status, failures and SLA adherence per company code (BSR-17 - feasible); a documented continuity plan with SOPs, two trained backup owners, manual fallback and a one-business-day recovery objective (BSR-09).		Power BI run dashboard; SOP / BCPManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-17: central run dashboard - feasible per the register.
38Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4Step changeWrite the commentary for open items and debit balances
Anomaly detection flags unusual ageing, debit balances on payables and unexpected movements before the SME opens the pack (BSR-16 - feasible). AI-drafted commentary for the SME to edit is a later step once enough data supports the logic (BSR-15 - future, P2P feedback).		Anomaly model over open items; LLM commentary draft (future)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-16 (anomaly detection, feasible) and BSR-15 (AI commentary, future).
39Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4Copilot agent optionCopilot in Excel
Copilot drafts the commentary on open items and debit balances from the ageing and prior-period comments, for the preparer to confirm.		Copilot in ExcelManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
40Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 5Step changeCapture the control evidence
System-generated evidence replaces screenshots: the SAP-team HTML extract carries the export time stamp, plus record counts, control totals and the run manifest (BSR-12 - feasible); one evidence and control standard across towers (BSR-33).		Run manifests; SAP HTML extract time stampManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-12 / BSR-33: system-generated evidence - feasible per the register.
41Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 6Step changeUpload the reconciliation to BlackLine
Standard packs are submitted through the BlackLine API just obtained (BSR-18 - future, together with BSR-13); one combined P2P + R2R BlackLine report at the lowest granularity serves both towers (BSR-26).		BlackLine APIManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-18 / BSR-26: BlackLine API submission - future; API standard to be aligned across towers.
42Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1Step changeValidate the invoice and payment nature
A WHT determination assistant classifies the payment nature from the invoice text, contract and supplier profile and proposes applicability and code per the market SOP.		LLM classifier; market WHT rule set (Tax)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe WHT process is subjective (payment nature, supporting documents) and it is not confirmed that Coupa can take an additional AI layer; not covered by the global non-PO project.
43Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1Copilot / Microsoft AI optionCopilot Studio agent
An agent classifies the payment nature from the invoice text and the supporting documents and proposes the WHT applicability for AP to confirm.		Copilot Studio agentManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
44Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 2Step changeCheck the WHT code in the vendor master
Vendor-master WHT codes are checked for completeness and consistency against the market rule set before the invoice arrives; gaps go to DMT as a maintenance request.		SAP vendor master; DMT request APIManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
45Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 4Step changeValidate the WHT calculation
The Vietnam fractional and Korea partial-exemption calculations run in a validated calculator (WHT engine) rather than off-system spreadsheets, writing the WHT base and amount back to Coupa.		WHT engine (Tax Miro deck, TAX-01 target)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
46Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 3Step changeAP posts the down payment in SAP
The approved Coupa down-payment form posts the F-47 request in SAP automatically and writes the SAP reference and payment date back to Coupa.		Coupa form to SAP integration / RPA (F-47)Manual → AutomatedCan be exploredCoupa custom form (Others): the extraction and SAP posting would need a bot / RPA or an integration - Celonis cannot post. China already posts automatically through iPay (Variant 2b).
47Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 6Step changeClear the down payment against the final invoice
When the final invoice posts, the down payment is proposed for clearing (F-54 / F-44) by matching PO, vendor and amount; partial clearings are proposed with the difference for AP to confirm.		SAP matching rule / RPAManual → Semi-automatedUnder assessmentAutomation of the down payment clearing is currently being explored by AP (not the payment-method-M clearing).
48Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3Step changeSupplier submits the invoice; AP processes it
An invoice chaser is triggered when a debit entry is posted without a matching invoice: the supplier / requestor is reminded with the debit details and escalated by ageing.		SAP debit entries; Power Automate / emailSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredSuppliers do not always submit the invoice promptly after the debit - the chaser can be explored.
49Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3Copilot agent optionCopilot in Outlook
Copilot drafts the invoice chaser to the supplier / requester from the debit entry details.		Copilot in OutlookSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
50Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 4Step changeInvoice posted; debit cleared
Debit entries are matched and cleared against the posted invoice automatically on vendor, amount and date; AP clears only the residue.		SAP automatic clearing (F.13) rulesManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAutomatic matching and clearing of the debit against the posted invoice can be explored.
51Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receiptAutomationGR ageing monitor and nudge agent
Monitor POs with invoices waiting in Pending receipt, nudge the requisitioner and escalate by ageing; report GR lead time by market against the P2P KPIs (Payment to Terms, Invoice TAT).		——Already implementedThe GR reminder is already in place (Coupa notifications, email reminders, team script); the global P2P team is exploring the receipt-related AI use cases.
52Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel)AITouchless capture for unstructured invoices
LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of Kofax with confidence-based routing; target: most PDF and email invoices reach Coupa with no AP touch.		——Can be exploredLLM extraction and semantic matching on top of the existing OCR - to be explored; Kofax itself is being replaced by a new global tool.
53Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in CoupaAIException-resolution agent for Coupa holds
One agent works the Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold and Pending receipt queues: proposes the fix, chases the right person and releases within policy; AP supervises by exception.		——Already implementedCovered by the global non-PO project (just live), the existing Coupa notifications and the Coupa variance threshold.
54Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP postingAutomationPosting-error auto-remediation
Classify Coupa-to-SAP posting errors, auto-apply the known fix and re-push, and feed error patterns back to DMT master-data quality.		——Already implementedSAP posting error messages are part of the existing design; AP investigates from the message.
55Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency paymentsAutomationPayment-failure triage
Classify payment-run failures, pre-fill the manual payment request and track the vendor clearing (F-44) so the exception closes without re-keying.		——Already implementedPayment-failure handling sits with Cash & Banking (PSPC initiative) - to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
56Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changesAutomationStraight-through early payment requests
Policy-based auto-approval, approval matrix from the DOA master and automated payment-date change in SAP.		——Can be exploredLow impact; the approval matrix part is not relevant, the SAP days update can be explored.
57Month-end closeProcess ImprovementOne accrual ownership model across P2P, R2R, Controlling and FP&A Ops
Agree who accrues what (pending approval vs approved-not-posted vs ad hoc vs departmental), close the Coupa AP vs Coupa P2P scope question, bring Controlling and FP&A Ops into the design, revisit the non-PO guideline as the root lever and take the continue / stop decision to local finance with the data.		——Under assessmentTPI NPO-19 / 20 / 21 / 27: accrual ownership across the towers.
58Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6)AutomationSystem-generated non-PO accruals (target Q1 2027)
Once the common global framework and RACI are agreed (Nov-Dec 2026), accruals are generated by the system from Coupa / Celonis data with controller review; the Python asset is the bridge until then.		——Under assessmentTPI NPO-08: system-generated accruals from Q1 2027 once the framework and RACI are agreed.
59Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reportingAIControl execution assistant
Runs the SOP-defined checks over scheduled extracts, drafts the control result and packages system-generated evidence for OneGRC.		——Not relevantControl execution needs human validation.
60Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR)AutomationShared automation platform for all towers
The VM, repository, governance, run dashboard, coverage inventory and training pack built for P2P BSR serve O2C, Controlling and Tax too (BSR-30 feasible; BSR-31, BSR-34, BSR-35); align with the R2R-led global BSR programme and adopt what R2R has built (BSR-21, BSR-22), with GPO / GPDD endorsement (BSR-23), Genpact (BSR-27) and named regional owners (BSR-29).		——Can be exploredTPI BSR-30 / 31 / 32 / 35: the framework offered to all towers - feasible per the register.

Kofax + LLM document extraction (Azure Document Intelligence / GPT); Coupa PO line data
OCR extraction is in place; the LLM layer to match line items by meaning (low-confidence cases routed to AP) is the new part - to be explored.
Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4

AP verifies and completes the extracted dataAP reviews only the fields below the confidence threshold; high-confidence invoices pass straight to Coupa. Kofax-to-Coupa transmission is monitored on a dashboard rather than by a daily manual check.
Kofax confidence scores; Celonis / Power BI transmission monitor
Confidence-based review (e.g. 80% threshold for straight-through) can be explored; the transmission monitoring belongs after the export, and the Celonis dashboard already exists.
Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4
Copilot in Outlook / Kofax queueCopilot drafts the query to the supplier or requester for the fields that could not be extracted, from the invoice image and the PO.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 5a
Raise a ServiceNow ticket and resolveInterface monitoring detects Kofax-Coupa failures and raises the ServiceNow incident with the invoice reference automatically; AP tracks the resolution.

A ServiceNow ticket is raised only after the team validates that the integration failure is technical; automatic ticket creation is not relevant. Transmission monitoring (Celonis dashboard) is already implemented.
Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 1a

Exception - missing information or holdAn agent completes missing invoice details from the PO, supplier record and remit-to master, maps the remit-to address and proposes the hold release; AP approves the proposal instead of keying the data.
Coupa API; vendor master (DMT); LLM agent
Covered by the global non-PO project that just went live.
Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2a
Exception - missing receiptAutomated GR chaser: the requestor is reminded on a schedule with the PO and invoice attached and escalated by ageing; AP steps in only when the chaser fails.
Coupa notifications; Power Automate / Teams; Celonis ageing
Coupa notifications and the team script already chase missing receipts; the global P2P receipt initiative covers the rest.
Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2b
Exception - price variance (On Hold)A variance assistant explains the difference (price list, contract, FX, quantity) and auto-accepts variances within policy; AP decides only the residual cases.
Coupa; contract / price-list data; LLM assistant
Coupa standard: price variances within the approved threshold are auto-approved and the variance assistant already states whether the PO unit price or the total is off.
Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1

Approver reviews the invoice in CoupaThe approver receives a one-paragraph variance summary (what differs from the PO, why, policy position) with a recommended action. Harmonise the over-delivery tolerance between Coupa and SAP Direct Materials so the same invoice is not blocked twice.
Coupa approval to-do + LLM summary; tolerance master alignment (Coupa / SAP)
Nice to have, low impact. The Coupa / SAP over-delivery tolerance difference is a known S/4 issue, not a separate AI solution.
Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1
Copilot in Coupa / OutlookCopilot summarises what differs from the PO and the policy position for the approver, instead of a one-paragraph summary built into Coupa.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 2a

Exception - SAP posting errorPosting errors are classified by type; known types (missing WHT code, blocked vendor, closed period) trigger the fix request to DMT / Ops IT and the re-push (Exported = No) automatically. AP handles only unknown errors.
Coupa-SAP error log; rules + LLM classifier; ServiceNow API
SAP already shows the posting error message; the remaining effort is AP investigation of the message - part of the existing design.
Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2
Investigate and assess the resolutionA failure root-cause classifier (invalid characters, bank details, format, system) proposes whether a re-run or a manual payment is needed.
SAP F110 log; rules / ML classifier

Payment-failure handling is covered by the Cash & Banking PSPC initiative; SAP shows the high-level failure and AP / Cash & Banking judge re-run vs manual payment. Ownership to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2
Copilot in Excel / OutlookCopilot drafts the investigation note from the SAP failure message and the vendor master, for AP and Cash & Banking to decide on re-run vs manual payment.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 3

Reverse the payment document and raise the manual payment requestThe manual payment request in CROWN is pre-filled from the SAP document (payment details, supporting documents, root cause) for the Payment Processor to confirm.
CROWN is being replaced by Cash & Banking; the pre-filled request depends on the new tool.
Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2
Block the invoice, troubleshoot and resolveBank-detail and vendor-master validation (IBAN / SWIFT format, country rules) runs before the next payment run and proposes the correction to DMT.
Vendor master validation service; bank format rules; DMT request API
MDG already validates the bank details (IBAN, bank name, format) before DMT maintains them in SAP - implemented upfront, not before the payment run.
Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the rejection reasons and the bank-detail rules lists the likely cause and the correction for AP before the invoice is unblocked.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 1a
Business and P2P Ops approvalDrive the ServiceNow approval matrix from the DOA / HR hierarchy master so it maintains itself; approvals route automatically and every change is audited.
The right procurement leaders cannot be identified from the HR hierarchy today.
Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 2
AP reviews the approvals and adjusts the payment dateOnce approved, the Days field update in SAP (FB02) is applied by the workflow and the ticket closes automatically.
Minimal impact; the workflow calculation of the payment days and the ownership need to be validated.
Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 1

Notification of incoming fundsIncoming funds are matched to the supplier automatically from remittance text, amount and open credits (the same ML matching pattern as O2C cash application); unmatched items are listed for AP with the best candidates.
Bank statement / Lockbox data; ML matching (BlackLine-style); SAP
Cash & Banking process - ownership of the incoming-funds posting to be confirmed with Cash & Banking (Angie) before this is taken further.
Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 2
Book the item in SAPMatched items are posted automatically (F42 / FB01) with the proposed account; AP books only the unmatched residue.
Cash & Banking books the items it can identify; the automatic proposal would cover the unmatched residue - to confirm with Cash & Banking (Angie).
Payment · Flow 6 - Control: duplicate payment monitoring (Xelix) · step 2
AP examines each caseExtend duplicate detection to down payments (special GL items) and non-invoice payments, and use the Xelix outcome history to auto-release known false positives.
Xelix configuration; SAP special GL data
Xelix already covers down payments; the high-risk scenarios (e.g. invoice posted before the down payment) are under review.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 1
Set the Coupa interface cut-off in SAPSchedule the Coupa interface cut-off from the month-end calendar (one variant per company code) instead of keying the dates.
Month-end interface cut-off scheduling is in progress.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 2

Posting-error population moves to Coupa P2P / R2R scopeCoupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P and leave the non-PO accrual population (P2P feedback on NPO-09). Approved-but-not-posted items are accrued once, under the ownership agreed between P2P and R2R (NPO-19, NPO-20).
Coupa P2P; R2R AJD stuck-invoice accrual
TPI Non-PO Accrual NPO-09 / NPO-26: Coupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 3

Extract non-PO invoices pending in Coupa (Celonis)The Python asset already built pulls the Celonis Non PO Account Allocation extract on schedule (NPO-01); Celonis stays the data source (P2P feedback on NPO-12 / NPO-34).
Celonis Coupa Control Tower; Python script
TPI NPO-01: the Python script that pulls the Celonis extract on schedule is already built.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 4

Consolidate and apply the exclusion criteriaThe Python script consolidates the extracts and applies the exclusion logic held as versioned, machine-readable rules with an audit trail (NPO-10). Milestone-based accruals read the percentage of completion from Veeva / WorkMate (NPO-02); the country-level data crunch (NPO-07) decides which population survives the elimination decision.
Python; rules engine; Veeva / WorkMate integration; manual journal dashboard (NPO-04)
TPI NPO-10 (exclusion logic as a rules engine) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 5

Raise the accrual journal in BlackLineThe journal is prepared by the script and pre-validated against BlackLine master data (GL, cost centre, internal order) before import, so the re-upload loop disappears (NPO-11). Straight-through posting (NPO-17 pattern) to be reassessed with R2R for China per P2P feedback.
Python; BlackLine import / API; master-data validation
TPI NPO-11 (journal pre-validation against BlackLine master data) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 6

China: contribution accrual and pre-payment offsettingAutomate the China contribution accrual on WorkMate with R2R by August 2026 and handle the pre-payment offsetting inside the automation so the separate step disappears (NPO-05, NPO-06); reuse the China commitment-report dashboard already in build (NPO-03).
WorkMate; R2R posting; Controllership commitment dashboard
TPI NPO-05 / NPO-06: China contribution accrual automation on WorkMate with R2R.
Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 1
Extract the control reportsControl reports are extracted on schedule (SAP job scheduling / Celonis export) into the control workspace.
Control reports are already extracted with Celonis and Python.
Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2

Execute the controls per the mini-SOX SOPA control assistant runs the mini-SOX SOP checks over the extracted reports and drafts the control result for AP to confirm; exceptions are listed with their evidence.
Python / Power Automate; LLM assistant over the SOP
Control execution needs human validation of the exceptions.
Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the mini-SOX SOP walks the control steps and drafts the control result for the preparer to validate - the exceptions stay with AP.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 3
Submit the control file and evidence in OneGRCSystem-generated evidence (record counts, run manifest, time-stamped extracts) replaces screenshots and is uploaded to OneGRC by workflow.
Evidence extraction is automated with Python; the scripts can still fail when line items exceed the predefined rules - to be raised with the COE Digital team.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 1

Update the GL checklistThe GL checklist is driven from the BlackLine and GL master (BSR-13 - future; companies not on BlackLine still to be understood) and carries the company code + GL account list, so onboarding an entity is a data change, not a code change (BSR-19 - feasible).
BlackLine / GL master; GL checklist file as configuration
TPI BSR-13 / BSR-19: GL checklist driven from the BlackLine / GL master; configuration-driven company-code onboarding raised in the retro.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 2

Extract the SAP balance and open-item reportsSAP job scheduling runs the extraction server-side on predefined variants, removing individual SAP access and the screen-coordinate dependency (BSR-02, BSR-11 - feasible). One shared extraction service can serve BSR, non-PO accrual and other towers if the templates align (BSR-32). Reading from Snowflake is not pursued (BSR-14 feedback); what already sits there is to be assessed (BSR-28).
SAP job scheduling; shared extraction service
TPI BSR-02 / BSR-11: SAP job scheduling replaces GUI extraction - raised in session.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3

Prepare the reconciliation from the entity templateOne common automation framework on a standardised BlackLine template (BSR-01, BSR-03) runs on a centralised, governed VM (BSR-04; request via DevOps, BSR-25) with scheduling, logging and alerting (BSR-05), version control (BSR-06) and a central SharePoint repository (BSR-08); coverage extends to the remaining 582 GL account assignments (BSR-07) and the design anticipates Axial / S/4HANA (BSR-10).
Python framework; central VM; SharePoint repository
TPI BSR-01 / 03 / 04-08: common template and framework on a centralised VM - raised in session.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3a

Fix or rerun the script; prepare manuallyA central Power BI run dashboard shows status, failures and SLA adherence per company code (BSR-17 - feasible); a documented continuity plan with SOPs, two trained backup owners, manual fallback and a one-business-day recovery objective (BSR-09).
Power BI run dashboard; SOP / BCP
TPI BSR-17: central run dashboard - feasible per the register.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4

Write the commentary for open items and debit balancesAnomaly detection flags unusual ageing, debit balances on payables and unexpected movements before the SME opens the pack (BSR-16 - feasible). AI-drafted commentary for the SME to edit is a later step once enough data supports the logic (BSR-15 - future, P2P feedback).
Anomaly model over open items; LLM commentary draft (future)
TPI BSR-16 (anomaly detection, feasible) and BSR-15 (AI commentary, future).
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4
Copilot in ExcelCopilot drafts the commentary on open items and debit balances from the ageing and prior-period comments, for the preparer to confirm.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 5

Capture the control evidenceSystem-generated evidence replaces screenshots: the SAP-team HTML extract carries the export time stamp, plus record counts, control totals and the run manifest (BSR-12 - feasible); one evidence and control standard across towers (BSR-33).
Run manifests; SAP HTML extract time stamp
TPI BSR-12 / BSR-33: system-generated evidence - feasible per the register.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 6

Upload the reconciliation to BlackLineStandard packs are submitted through the BlackLine API just obtained (BSR-18 - future, together with BSR-13); one combined P2P + R2R BlackLine report at the lowest granularity serves both towers (BSR-26).
TPI BSR-18 / BSR-26: BlackLine API submission - future; API standard to be aligned across towers.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1

Validate the invoice and payment natureA WHT determination assistant classifies the payment nature from the invoice text, contract and supplier profile and proposes applicability and code per the market SOP.
LLM classifier; market WHT rule set (Tax)
The WHT process is subjective (payment nature, supporting documents) and it is not confirmed that Coupa can take an additional AI layer; not covered by the global non-PO project.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1
Copilot Studio agentAn agent classifies the payment nature from the invoice text and the supporting documents and proposes the WHT applicability for AP to confirm.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 2

Check the WHT code in the vendor masterVendor-master WHT codes are checked for completeness and consistency against the market rule set before the invoice arrives; gaps go to DMT as a maintenance request.
SAP vendor master; DMT request API
The whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 4

Validate the WHT calculationThe Vietnam fractional and Korea partial-exemption calculations run in a validated calculator (WHT engine) rather than off-system spreadsheets, writing the WHT base and amount back to Coupa.
WHT engine (Tax Miro deck, TAX-01 target)
The whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 3
AP posts the down payment in SAPThe approved Coupa down-payment form posts the F-47 request in SAP automatically and writes the SAP reference and payment date back to Coupa.
Coupa form to SAP integration / RPA (F-47)
Coupa custom form (Others): the extraction and SAP posting would need a bot / RPA or an integration - Celonis cannot post. China already posts automatically through iPay (Variant 2b).
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 6

Clear the down payment against the final invoiceWhen the final invoice posts, the down payment is proposed for clearing (F-54 / F-44) by matching PO, vendor and amount; partial clearings are proposed with the difference for AP to confirm.
Automation of the down payment clearing is currently being explored by AP (not the payment-method-M clearing).
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3

Supplier submits the invoice; AP processes itAn invoice chaser is triggered when a debit entry is posted without a matching invoice: the supplier / requestor is reminded with the debit details and escalated by ageing.
SAP debit entries; Power Automate / email
Suppliers do not always submit the invoice promptly after the debit - the chaser can be explored.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the invoice chaser to the supplier / requester from the debit entry details.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 4
Invoice posted; debit clearedDebit entries are matched and cleared against the posted invoice automatically on vendor, amount and date; AP clears only the residue.
Automatic matching and clearing of the debit against the posted invoice can be explored.
Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receipt

GR ageing monitor and nudge agentMonitor POs with invoices waiting in Pending receipt, nudge the requisitioner and escalate by ageing; report GR lead time by market against the P2P KPIs (Payment to Terms, Invoice TAT).
The GR reminder is already in place (Coupa notifications, email reminders, team script); the global P2P team is exploring the receipt-related AI use cases.
Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel)
Touchless capture for unstructured invoicesLLM extraction and semantic matching on top of Kofax with confidence-based routing; target: most PDF and email invoices reach Coupa with no AP touch.
LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of the existing OCR - to be explored; Kofax itself is being replaced by a new global tool.
Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa

Exception-resolution agent for Coupa holdsOne agent works the Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold and Pending receipt queues: proposes the fix, chases the right person and releases within policy; AP supervises by exception.
Covered by the global non-PO project (just live), the existing Coupa notifications and the Coupa variance threshold.
Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting
Posting-error auto-remediationClassify Coupa-to-SAP posting errors, auto-apply the known fix and re-push, and feed error patterns back to DMT master-data quality.
SAP posting error messages are part of the existing design; AP investigates from the message.
Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments
Payment-failure triageClassify payment-run failures, pre-fill the manual payment request and track the vendor clearing (F-44) so the exception closes without re-keying.
Payment-failure handling sits with Cash & Banking (PSPC initiative) - to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes
Straight-through early payment requestsPolicy-based auto-approval, approval matrix from the DOA master and automated payment-date change in SAP.
Low impact; the approval matrix part is not relevant, the SAP days update can be explored.

One accrual ownership model across P2P, R2R, Controlling and FP&A OpsAgree who accrues what (pending approval vs approved-not-posted vs ad hoc vs departmental), close the Coupa AP vs Coupa P2P scope question, bring Controlling and FP&A Ops into the design, revisit the non-PO guideline as the root lever and take the continue / stop decision to local finance with the data.
TPI NPO-19 / 20 / 21 / 27: accrual ownership across the towers.
Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6)

System-generated non-PO accruals (target Q1 2027)Once the common global framework and RACI are agreed (Nov-Dec 2026), accruals are generated by the system from Coupa / Celonis data with controller review; the Python asset is the bridge until then.
TPI NPO-08: system-generated accruals from Q1 2027 once the framework and RACI are agreed.
Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting
Control execution assistantRuns the SOP-defined checks over scheduled extracts, drafts the control result and packages system-generated evidence for OneGRC.
Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR)

Shared automation platform for all towersThe VM, repository, governance, run dashboard, coverage inventory and training pack built for P2P BSR serve O2C, Controlling and Tax too (BSR-30 feasible; BSR-31, BSR-34, BSR-35); align with the R2R-led global BSR programme and adopt what R2R has built (BSR-21, BSR-22), with GPO / GPDD endorsement (BSR-23), Genpact (BSR-27) and named regional owners (BSR-29).
TPI BSR-30 / 31 / 32 / 35: the framework offered to all towers - feasible per the register.
Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments
Down payment straight-throughApproved form posts the down payment, the payment run pays it and the final invoice clears it - AP confirms partial clearings only.
Coupa (Others) down payment straight-through needs a bot / integration; China already auto-posts via iPay.

rows: Remove P2P vendor posting from the China process
China intragroup transfers now go bank-to-bank, so P2P no longer posts the request to a vendor account or raises manual F110 payment instructions.
Direct change to a P2P step
Use Crown for intragroup transfer requests and approvals

Intragroup transfer requests and DOA approvals run as a Crown workflow - the platform P2P already uses for manual payment requests, so the approval pattern can be reused for the AP Payment Lead approval.
Integrate Crown request data with Payment Hub
Passing approved Crown request data into Payment Hub would also remove re-keying of P2P manual payment instructions by Cash & Banking.
Validating bank account, currency and approver authority against governed masters before release is the check that prevents P2P payments being rejected for bank-detail errors.
Automated Payment Hub to bank and ledger reconciliation
Matching request, payment instruction, bank confirmation and ledger entry would confirm P2P manual payments and leave only breaks for AP before the vendor open item is cleared.
R2R plans one reusable catalogue of mapping, eligibility, threshold and reconciliation logic for non-Coupa accruals - a natural home for the P2P non-PO accrual rules rather than a separate P2P build.
Can be implemented in the future
AI overlap detection across accrual populations
Flags probable overlap between R2R PO accruals, stuck invoices, pending receipts and the P2P non-PO population before two towers accrue the same cost.
Direct change to a P2P step
Governed accrual data product with MU mapping
One authorised accrual dataset for R2R, FP&A and Controlling; adding the P2P non-PO accrual lines gives a single accrual view across towers.
Rule-based IPR controls with controlled overrides
Codified eligibility, exclusion and threshold checks with controlled overrides - the same design as the P2P exclusion rules engine.
Can be implemented in the future
Shared extraction backbone using API, Snowflake or scheduled exports
One controlled access route (API, Snowflake or scheduled export) to BlackLine, Coupa, Celonis and SAP - the same sources P2P extracts for the non-PO accrual and the BSR.
Matching prior accruals to receipts, invoices and reversals would show which P2P non-PO accruals stay open beyond the expected cycle.
AI forecast of late-receipt and reversal risk
Ranks open accruals likely to stay unresolved because the receipt is late - the same Pending receipt population P2P chases with requisitioners.
Direct change to a P2P step

Proposes feeding the P2P and R2R accrual lists into the FP&A pre-close P&L as expected postings, so the non-PO accrual output would become an input to FP&A.

A scheduled SAP extraction built once for all towers would replace the GUI-driven extraction in the BSR.

The FC&CG scheduled SAP extraction is offered to P2P - a ready alternative to building P2P its own extraction job.

asIs.html:
Order to Cash · Order to Invoice, Collections and Banking · Sales order creation, Order block release, Billing, Collections & disputes, Payment allocation, Cash & Banking

Order to Cash As-Is Process Map

Convert distributor EDI sales, customer purchase orders, returns and rebates into valid SAP sales orders or credit notes, then release blocked orders, bill them and collect payment; apply the cash received to customer accounts in High Radius, run outgoing payments and post the bank statements through to the bank reconciliation in BlackLine, handed to R2R Reporting for month-end close.

asIs.title: Key processes · what each one does
asIs.html:
Key processes · what each one does

As documented with the O2C teams (register Oct 2026) · owner, window and flows in each phase.

#Key processWhat happensOwnerWindowFlows
1Sales order creationSOC-01SAP processes the daily distributor EDI file; the Sales Order team fixes missing end-customer accounts, prices and stock. Customer POs, returns and rebates are entered manually after approval, then pass the system credit check.O2C Sales Order teamDaily · Semi-automated · SAPFlow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) (SOC-01.1)
Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) (SOC-01.2)
2Order block releaseSOC-02Manual orders that fail the SAP credit check are blocked. The block reason is identified and Credit Risk or Collection approves the release.O2C Order Release, Credit Risk and Collection teamsDaily · Semi-automated · SAP, High RadiusOrder block release (manual orders) (SOC-02.1)
3BillingSOC-03Delivery to the customer triggers the PGI posting. Billing is released, invoices and credit notes are generated and sent, with local tax invoices and e-invoicing where mandated.O2C Billing teamDaily · Semi-automated · SAP, local e-invoicing portalsBilling (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) (SOC-03.1)
4Collections & disputes managementSOC-04Monthly SOA, pre-due reminders and payment chasing with escalation. Disputes and deductions are recorded, investigated and resolved by credit note or invoice correction.O2C Collection teamDaily; monthly SOA and reminders · Semi-automated · High Radius, SAPCollection - payment follow-up and escalation (SOC-04.1)
Disputes and deductions management (SOC-04.2)
5Payment allocation / cash applicationSOC-05Daily bank statements feed High Radius, which auto-matches payments to invoices and posts the output file to SAP. Unmatched payments are checked and cleared manually.O2C Cash Application teamDaily · Semi-automated · High Radius Cash Application, SAPPayment allocation - matched payments (SOC-05.1)
6Cash & BankingSOC-06Outgoing payments run through the SAP payment run or the manual route in Crown. Bank statements are posted, open items cleared and the bank reconciled in BlackLine.O2C Cash & Banking teamDaily · Semi-automated · SAP, Crown, FIS Payment Hub, bank portals, BlackLineFlow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run (SOC-06.1)
Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route (SOC-06.2)
Flow B - Bank statement process (SOC-06.3)
