ai.title: AI opportunities 14
ai.html:
AI opportunities 14

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations and TPI register patterns · hypotheses to validate
DigitalizationOrder-to-invoice exception dashboard by market and cause
Phase · Sales order creation · O2C-01 - Claude recommendation

Bring EDI errors, manual-order exceptions and order blocks from SAP into one Power BI view by market, customer and root cause (account, price, stock, VAT, credit) so the Sales Order, Credit Risk and Billing teams fix master data and credit settings instead of case-by-case follow-up.

AutomationAuto-triage EDI order errors to the resolving team
Flow · Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) · O2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation

A scheduled script extracts the daily EDI order error log from SAP, classifies each error (missing end-customer account, missing price, insufficient stock) and raises it to DMT / Distribution, the market and Controlling, or Distribution with a tracked status - replacing email follow-up by the Sales Order team.

DigitalizationPre-creation master-data validation (customer, price, VAT)
Flow · Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) · O2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation

Before an order or credit note is created, check the customer account status, price condition and VAT classification against SAP master data and flag mismatches to DMT, stopping incorrect VAT at source rather than at the invoice.

AIPredictive credit-block reduction for CNXX markets
Phase · Order block release · O2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation

Use twelve months of block, release and payment history to recommend credit-limit adjustments for customers repeatedly blocked but paying on time, for Credit Risk approval - reducing the volume of blocks at source alongside the Banker's Acceptance exclusion.

AutomationRelease-on-approval workflow with evidence trail
Flow · Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · O2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation

One workflow for the three block reasons: the blocked order generates the approval request with the exposure summary, routes it to the GDOA 2002 / Credit Risk Policy / GDOA 2000 approver, stores the evidence and triggers the SAP release by script.

AutomationE-invoice submission and status monitoring
Flow · Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · O2C-01.06 - Claude recommendation

Automatic submission of SAP billing data to each mandated tax-authority portal, status write-back to SAP and a rejection queue by market, so new e-invoicing mandates are onboarded as configuration rather than new manual steps.

DigitalizationOverpayment and refund tracker (China aged overpayments)
Phase · Collections & disputes management · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Age customer overpayments in High Radius / SAP, trigger the refund request to Cash & Banking once the market criteria are met and report aged balances by customer, replacing manual follow-up of China overpayments.

AIPredictive payment-risk scoring
Flow · Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Score open invoices by likelihood of late payment from High Radius history (customer, market, past commitments kept) to focus pre-due calls on the invoices most at risk and recommend when to escalate.

AutomationDeduction-to-credit-note matching
Flow · Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Match customer deductions taken on payment to open or approved claims (returns, rebates, AP-due invoices) before the credit note is issued, so valid deductions clear on posting and invalid ones return to collections with the evidence attached.

DigitalizationAuto-match rate monitoring by market and unmatched reason
Flow · Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched payments · O2C-02.04 - Claude recommendation

A Power BI view of the High Radius auto-match rate by market and the reason for each unmatched payment (no remittance, lump sum, advance, short-pay) so rule tuning and customer remittance requests target the biggest causes.

AutomationPayment-to-bank-to-ledger reconciliation
Phase · Cash & Banking · O2C-03 - TPI register ICT-13

Match each payment request, payment instruction, bank confirmation and accounting entry automatically and route only the breaks for investigation - covering the automated run, manual payments and the bank statement in one control.

AutomationPre-payment beneficiary and duplicate validation
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · O2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-11 / ICT-12

Validate beneficiary bank details, currency, amount limits and approver authority against governed masters and check for duplicate payments before the file is released, so rejections and re-issues fall at source.

DigitalizationManual payment status and exception dashboard
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route · O2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-14

Show each Crown request's age, approval stage, payment status, cut-off risk and rejection reason in one view for the Cash & Banking team and requesters, replacing status emails.

DigitalizationOpen-item ageing and ownership dashboard
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · O2C-03.02 - TPI register PAY-10 pattern applied to bank open items

One reconciled list of bank open items by category, stakeholder, age and status (payroll, T&E, vendor refunds, unidentified) so the follow-up is worked from a single view and aged items are visible before month-end.

22Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 1Step changeRecord the dispute in High Radius and SAP

23Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 2Step changeInvestigate the disputed invoice / deduction
Dispute triage assistant: classify the deduction (return, rebate, AP-due invoice, pricing), pull the matching return or rebate approval, the invoice and the P2P AP status, and route one validation request to the owning team with an SLA and reminders. 24Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 2Copilot agent optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
An agent grounded on the dispute playbook, contract terms and delivery proofs suggests the likely root cause and drafts the response for the analyst.		Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)—Under ReviewAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
25Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 3Step changeCredit note / invoice correction
Create the credit note automatically from the validated claim (approved return or rebate) using the Alexion-style script and close the dispute in High Radius on posting.		Python (Alexion script pattern), SAP credit note, High Radius dispute closeSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be explored & implemented—
26Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched payments · step 4Step changeManual check & clear in High Radius / SAP
Raise the HRC auto-match rate: AI remittance capture (email and PDF remittances parsed into High Radius), review of tolerance and FIFO rules for China and Korea advances, and a suggested-match queue so the team confirms rather than searches.		High Radius remittance capture (AI), HRC matching rule tuning, Python remittance parsingManual → Semi-automatedCan be explored—
27Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 2Step changeReconcile payment file with bank confirmation
Automate the reconciliation of the SAP settlement list with the bank acknowledgment file: match by payment reference and amount, post the control evidence automatically and list only the breaks for the team.		Python, SAP settlement list extract, FIS Payment Hub acknowledgment fileSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be explored & implemented—
28Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 3Step changeInvestigate payment rejection for resolution
Map bank rejection reason codes to a cause (invalid bank details, currency, cut-off, sanctions) and route each rejection to the owning team (P2P vendor master, HR, Tax, Collections) with a tracked status; validate beneficiary bank details before the next run.		Bank reason-code mapping table, Power Automate routing, pre-payment master-data validationManual → Semi-automatedNot Feasible—
29Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 3Copilot agent optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)

Python conversion to CAMT / MT940 format, SAP electronic bank statement uploadSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be explored & implemented—

Python classification, Power Automate routing, Power BI ageing dashboard, SAP bank clearing accountsManual → Semi-automatedNot Feasible—

BlackLine API, BSR automation framework on the governed VM, SAP job schedulingSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredAPI with GBS

39Sales order creationDigitalizationOrder-to-invoice exception dashboard by market and cause
Bring EDI errors, manual-order exceptions and order blocks from SAP into one Power BI view by market, customer and root cause (account, price, stock, VAT, credit) so the Sales Order, Credit Risk and Billing teams fix master data and credit settings instead of case-by-case follow-up.		——Not RequiredO2C-01 - Claude recommendation
40Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic)AutomationAuto-triage EDI order errors to the resolving team
A scheduled script extracts the daily EDI order error log from SAP, classifies each error (missing end-customer account, missing price, insufficient stock) and raises it to DMT / Distribution, the market and Controlling, or Distribution with a tracked status - replacing email follow-up by the Sales Order team.		——Can be explored & implementedO2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation
41Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual)DigitalizationPre-creation master-data validation (customer, price, VAT)
Before an order or credit note is created, check the customer account status, price condition and VAT classification against SAP master data and flag mismatches to DMT, stopping incorrect VAT at source rather than at the invoice.		——Can be explored & in progress for VAT Validation OnlyO2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation
42Order block releaseAIPredictive credit-block reduction for CNXX markets
Use twelve months of block, release and payment history to recommend credit-limit adjustments for customers repeatedly blocked but paying on time, for Credit Risk approval - reducing the volume of blocks at source alongside the Banker's Acceptance exclusion.		——Existing Dashboard in PlaceO2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation
43Order block release · Order block release (manual orders)AutomationRelease-on-approval workflow with evidence trail
One workflow for the three block reasons: the blocked order generates the approval request with the exposure summary, routes it to the GDOA 2002 / Credit Risk Policy / GDOA 2000 approver, stores the evidence and triggers the SAP release by script.		——Can be exploredO2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation
44Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing)AutomationE-invoice submission and status monitoring
Automatic submission of SAP billing data to each mandated tax-authority portal, status write-back to SAP and a rejection queue by market, so new e-invoicing mandates are onboarded as configuration rather than new manual steps.		——Can be explored & implementedO2C-01.06 - Claude recommendation
45Collections & disputes managementDigitalizationOverpayment and refund tracker (China aged overpayments)
Age customer overpayments in High Radius / SAP, trigger the refund request to Cash & Banking once the market criteria are met and report aged balances by customer, replacing manual follow-up of China overpayments.		——Can be explored & implementedO2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation
46Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalationAIPredictive payment-risk scoring
Score open invoices by likelihood of late payment from High Radius history (customer, market, past commitments kept) to focus pre-due calls on the invoices most at risk and recommend when to escalate.		——Can be explored & implementedO2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation
47Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions managementAutomationDeduction-to-credit-note matching
Match customer deductions taken on payment to open or approved claims (returns, rebates, AP-due invoices) before the credit note is issued, so valid deductions clear on posting and invalid ones return to collections with the evidence attached.		——Not FeasibleO2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation
48Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched paymentsDigitalizationAuto-match rate monitoring by market and unmatched reason
A Power BI view of the High Radius auto-match rate by market and the reason for each unmatched payment (no remittance, lump sum, advance, short-pay) so rule tuning and customer remittance requests target the biggest causes.		——Can be explored & implementedO2C-02.04 - Claude recommendation
49Cash & BankingAutomationPayment-to-bank-to-ledger reconciliation
Match each payment request, payment instruction, bank confirmation and accounting entry automatically and route only the breaks for investigation - covering the automated run, manual payments and the bank statement in one control.		——Not RequiredO2C-03 - TPI register ICT-13
50Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment runAutomationPre-payment beneficiary and duplicate validation
Validate beneficiary bank details, currency, amount limits and approver authority against governed masters and check for duplicate payments before the file is released, so rejections and re-issues fall at source.		——Not FeasibleO2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-11 / ICT-12
51Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment routeDigitalizationManual payment status and exception dashboard
Show each Crown request's age, approval stage, payment status, cut-off risk and rejection reason in one view for the Cash & Banking team and requesters, replacing status emails.		——Not RequiredO2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-14
52Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement processDigitalizationOpen-item ageing and ownership dashboard
One reconciled list of bank open items by category, stakeholder, age and status (payroll, T&E, vendor refunds, unidentified) so the follow-up is worked from a single view and aged items are visible before month-end.		——Not RequiredO2C-03.02 - TPI register PAY-10 pattern applied to bank open items

rows: Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) · step 1a

Create the end-customer accountAuto-raise the end-customer account request: a scheduled script reads the failed EDI lines from the SAP error log, pre-fills the DMT account request with the distributor end-customer details and tracks it to closure; SAP retries the EDI order once the account exists.
Python (SAP EDI error log extract), Power Automate, ServiceNow request to DMT, SAP customer master
Can be explored but implemented. DMT team had set up a robot to handle missing customer accounts
Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) · step 1b

Update the price (Market / Controlling)Detect price gaps before the EDI run: compare the distributor product list with SAP pricing conditions ahead of each daily load and raise missing or expiring conditions to the market and Controlling with a pre-filled pricing condition upload.
Python / SQL on SAP pricing extract, Power Automate email to market and Controlling, SAP pricing condition upload template
Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) · step 1c

Move stockStock-shortfall alert to Distribution: compare EDI order quantity with SAP available stock automatically and raise a pre-filled stock movement request; agree a partial-fulfilment rule so the available quantity proceeds to billing.
SAP MM stock extract, Python comparison, Power Automate request to Distribution
Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) · step 1

Receive PO, return or rebate requestIntelligent intake of customer POs, returns and rebate claims: documents from email and the customer portal are read by AI document extraction (customer, PO number, material, quantity, price, return or rebate reason) into one structured request queue for the Sales Order team.
Azure AI Document Intelligence or Power Automate AI Builder, shared mailbox rules, SharePoint request queue
Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) · step 1

Copilot Studio agent in OutlookThe agent reads the shared mailbox, drafts the structured request from the PO, return or rebate email and replies to the customer for missing details, alongside the document extraction.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) · step 2

Process Order / Credit note in SAPExtend the completed Alexion Python order-processing script to standard POs, returns and rebates in all markets: validated requests are created in SAP by script after a master-data pre-check (customer account, material, price condition, VAT code), so errors are caught before creation and only exceptions are keyed manually.
Python (existing Alexion script pattern), SAP BAPI / GUI scripting, master-data pre-validation against SAP customer, material and pricing tables
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · step 1

System credit check on manual ordersPrioritise the blocked-orders worklist: rank blocks daily by order value, block reason and customer payment behaviour, exclude Banker's Acceptance from the CNXX exposure (TPI go-live Q4 2026) and flag customers repeatedly blocked but paying on time for a credit-limit review.
SAP blocked orders list extract, Python scoring, Power BI worklist; TPI system change for CNXX
Fully automated by SAP. A Celonis dashboard has been developed for this
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · step 1a

Credit Risk approval (GDOA 2002)Generate the GDOA 2002 approval request automatically from the blocked order with the exposure summary (credit limit, current balance, new order, resulting exposure) and route it to the approver through a workflow; the evidenced approval is stored against the order.
Power Automate approvals, SAP blocked orders list, SharePoint evidence library
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · step 1b

Collection approval (Credit Risk Policy)Generate the overdue-balance approval request from High Radius ageing and payment commitments and route it under the Global Credit Risk Policy through a workflow, with the collector's notes attached automatically.
Power Automate approvals, High Radius ageing and notes extract, SharePoint evidence library
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · step 1c

Credit Risk approval (GDOA 2000)Generate the GDOA 2000 payment-term approval request from the SAP change log (old term, new term, requester) and route it through a workflow; evidenced approval stored against the order.
Power Automate approvals, SAP change log extract, SharePoint evidence library
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · step 2

Release the order on approvalRelease on approval: once the workflow approval is recorded, the release is executed in SAP by script with the approval reference, removing the re-keying step; manual release is kept for exceptions.
Python / SAP GUI scripting, Power Automate trigger on approval, SAP sales order processing
Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · step 2

Release billing for revenue recognitionScheduled billing-due-list run releases billing automatically for delivered orders that pass a master-data check; only exceptions (holds, incomplete data) go to the Billing team.
SAP batch job on the billing due list (VF04 / VF06), exception report to the Billing team
Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · step 3

Generate invoices / credit notesPre-billing VAT validation: compare the VAT code on each billing document with the customer and material tax classification rules and hold mismatches before output; corrections are routed to DMT so the master data is fixed at source.
Python / SQL on SAP billing extract, VAT rules table by market, Power Automate request to DMT
Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · step 4

Prepare the local tax invoiceGenerate the Vietnam and Korea local tax invoice from SAP billing data by script into the local template, so the Billing team reviews exceptions rather than preparing each invoice.
Python, SAP billing extract, local tax invoice template (Excel / PDF)
Can be explored & implemented for Vietnam
Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · step 5

Submit sales data to tax authorityDirect SAP-to-portal e-invoice integration (for example MyInvois API) with automatic submission, validation status write-back to SAP and a rejection queue; the same pattern is reused as further markets mandate e-invoicing.
SAP e-invoicing integration / middleware, tax authority portal API, rejection queue in Power BI
Can be explored & implemented in Edicom system
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 1

Send monthly SOA and pre-due remindersComplete the pre-due reminder script for Alexion Australia (TPI work in progress) and extend it to the monthly SOA; for China, generate WeCom-ready SOA messages for the sales representatives from High Radius data.
Python (existing TPI script), High Radius Collection Cloud extract, WeCom message template
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 1
Microsoft 365 Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the monthly SOA and pre-due reminder emails per customer from the open items, for the collector to review and send.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 2

Chase payment before the due datePrioritised collection worklist: rank customers by amount due, days to due date and payment behaviour, with AI-drafted reminder emails in High Radius for the collector to review and send.
High Radius Collection Cloud worklists, payment-behaviour scoring (Python), AI email drafting (Copilot)
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 2
Copilot Studio agentAn agent summarises the customer's open items and past promises to pay and drafts the chase message or call notes for the collector.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 3

Escalate to Line Manager / Team leadEscalation pack assembled automatically (ageing, commitments, dispute status, contact history) and routed to the Line Manager and the local KAM / Finance Controller through a workflow; payment-hold approvals are captured in the same workflow as evidence.
Power Automate, High Radius notes extract, SharePoint evidence library
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · step 3
Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams / OutlookCopilot summarises the account history and contact trail into a short escalation note for the Line Manager or Team lead.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 1

Record the dispute in High Radius and SAPCreate High Radius disputes automatically from short-payments detected in cash application and from portal or email claims, with the SAP dispute flag set by interface instead of by hand.
High Radius short-pay and dispute automation, HRC to SAP interface
Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 2

Investigate the disputed invoice / deductionDispute triage assistant: classify the deduction (return, rebate, AP-due invoice, pricing), pull the matching return or rebate approval, the invoice and the P2P AP status, and route one validation request to the owning team with an SLA and reminders.
Python classification, Power Automate routing, High Radius, SAP, P2P AP status lookup
Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the dispute playbook, contract terms and delivery proofs suggests the likely root cause and drafts the response for the analyst.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · step 3

Credit note / invoice correctionCreate the credit note automatically from the validated claim (approved return or rebate) using the Alexion-style script and close the dispute in High Radius on posting.
Python (Alexion script pattern), SAP credit note, High Radius dispute close
Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched payments · step 4

Manual check & clear in High Radius / SAPRaise the HRC auto-match rate: AI remittance capture (email and PDF remittances parsed into High Radius), review of tolerance and FIFO rules for China and Korea advances, and a suggested-match queue so the team confirms rather than searches.
High Radius remittance capture (AI), HRC matching rule tuning, Python remittance parsing
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 2

Reconcile payment file with bank confirmationAutomate the reconciliation of the SAP settlement list with the bank acknowledgment file: match by payment reference and amount, post the control evidence automatically and list only the breaks for the team.
Python, SAP settlement list extract, FIS Payment Hub acknowledgment file
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 3

Investigate payment rejection for resolutionMap bank rejection reason codes to a cause (invalid bank details, currency, cut-off, sanctions) and route each rejection to the owning team (P2P vendor master, HR, Tax, Collections) with a tracked status; validate beneficiary bank details before the next run.
Bank reason-code mapping table, Power Automate routing, pre-payment master-data validation
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · step 3
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the bank reason-code list explains each rejection and proposes the next action and owner.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route · step 1

Receive manual payment request (Crown)Crown bulk payment form (TPI work in progress) for Gateway tax and FDA payments with mandatory fields and DOA approval inside the request; eligibility rules route anything the automated run can handle to the daily run instead.
Crown / ServiceNow bulk payment form, eligibility rules (entity, same-day need, cut-off)
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route · step 1
Copilot Studio agent in TeamsAn agent checks the Crown bulk payment request for completeness and missing approvals and asks the requester for the gaps before it reaches the team.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route · step 2

Execute the manual paymentPass the approved Crown request data (beneficiary, bank, currency, amount, value date) straight into the FIS Payment Hub to remove re-keying, with a duplicate-transfer check before release.
Crown to FIS Payment Hub integration, duplicate detection rules
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 1
Receive the bank statementOnboard the remaining manual-statement banks to MT940 / CAMT53 through the FIS Payment Hub so more statements take the electronic route.
FIS Payment Hub bank connectivity, bank onboarding plan by market
Can be explored & in progress by PSBC Project
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 3

Manually post the bank statementConvert portal-downloaded statements into an electronic bank statement upload file by script so SAP posts them through the standard route; manual posting is kept only for exceptions.
Python conversion to CAMT / MT940 format, SAP electronic bank statement upload
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 4

Follow up with stakeholders & perform bank open item clearingBank open-item classifier: categorise open items (payroll, T&E, vendor refund, unidentified) from amount and reference patterns, route each to its stakeholder with a due date and age them in a dashboard; payroll payment holds post to the accrual GL instead of bank clearing (TPI work in progress).
Python classification, Power Automate routing, Power BI ageing dashboard, SAP bank clearing accounts
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 4
Copilot Studio agent in TeamsAn agent chases stakeholders on open bank items and records their replies against the item.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 5

Bank reconciliation in BlackLineSubmit the bank reconciliation to BlackLine through the API from the standardised BSR automation framework, with system-generated control evidence (record counts, control totals, run manifest) instead of screenshots.
BlackLine API, BSR automation framework on the governed VM, SAP job scheduling
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · step 5
Microsoft 365 Copilot in ExcelCopilot explains reconciliation breaks in the exported BlackLine items and drafts the exception notes for the analyst to confirm.
Added 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed

Order-to-invoice exception dashboard by market and causeBring EDI errors, manual-order exceptions and order blocks from SAP into one Power BI view by market, customer and root cause (account, price, stock, VAT, credit) so the Sales Order, Credit Risk and Billing teams fix master data and credit settings instead of case-by-case follow-up.
Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic)

Auto-triage EDI order errors to the resolving teamA scheduled script extracts the daily EDI order error log from SAP, classifies each error (missing end-customer account, missing price, insufficient stock) and raises it to DMT / Distribution, the market and Controlling, or Distribution with a tracked status - replacing email follow-up by the Sales Order team.
Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual)

Pre-creation master-data validation (customer, price, VAT)Before an order or credit note is created, check the customer account status, price condition and VAT classification against SAP master data and flag mismatches to DMT, stopping incorrect VAT at source rather than at the invoice.
Can be explored & in progress for VAT Validation Only

Predictive credit-block reduction for CNXX marketsUse twelve months of block, release and payment history to recommend credit-limit adjustments for customers repeatedly blocked but paying on time, for Credit Risk approval - reducing the volume of blocks at source alongside the Banker's Acceptance exclusion.
Order block release · Order block release (manual orders)

Release-on-approval workflow with evidence trailOne workflow for the three block reasons: the blocked order generates the approval request with the exposure summary, routes it to the GDOA 2002 / Credit Risk Policy / GDOA 2000 approver, stores the evidence and triggers the SAP release by script.

E-invoice submission and status monitoringAutomatic submission of SAP billing data to each mandated tax-authority portal, status write-back to SAP and a rejection queue by market, so new e-invoicing mandates are onboarded as configuration rather than new manual steps.

Overpayment and refund tracker (China aged overpayments)Age customer overpayments in High Radius / SAP, trigger the refund request to Cash & Banking once the market criteria are met and report aged balances by customer, replacing manual follow-up of China overpayments.
Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation

Predictive payment-risk scoringScore open invoices by likelihood of late payment from High Radius history (customer, market, past commitments kept) to focus pre-due calls on the invoices most at risk and recommend when to escalate.
Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management

Deduction-to-credit-note matchingMatch customer deductions taken on payment to open or approved claims (returns, rebates, AP-due invoices) before the credit note is issued, so valid deductions clear on posting and invalid ones return to collections with the evidence attached.
Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched payments

Auto-match rate monitoring by market and unmatched reasonA Power BI view of the High Radius auto-match rate by market and the reason for each unmatched payment (no remittance, lump sum, advance, short-pay) so rule tuning and customer remittance requests target the biggest causes.

Payment-to-bank-to-ledger reconciliationMatch each payment request, payment instruction, bank confirmation and accounting entry automatically and route only the breaks for investigation - covering the automated run, manual payments and the bank statement in one control.
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run

Pre-payment beneficiary and duplicate validationValidate beneficiary bank details, currency, amount limits and approver authority against governed masters and check for duplicate payments before the file is released, so rejections and re-issues fall at source.
Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route

Manual payment status and exception dashboardShow each Crown request's age, approval stage, payment status, cut-off risk and rejection reason in one view for the Cash & Banking team and requesters, replacing status emails.
Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process

Open-item ageing and ownership dashboardOne reconciled list of bank open items by category, stakeholder, age and status (payroll, T&E, vendor refunds, unidentified) so the follow-up is worked from a single view and aged items are visible before month-end.
O2C-03.02 - TPI register PAY-10 pattern applied to bank open items

Phase · Withholding Tax (Australia) · TAX-01 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Vendor tax rules, service classification, WHT determination, treaty validation and exception routing before posting, feeding the monthly payment file, the annual return and WHT certificates from the same calculation data - the Miro future state (Aug 2026).

Flow · Withholding Tax (Australia) · Phase 3 - WHT review and posting · TAX-01.3 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Classify the vendor, service and treaty position at invoice capture, propose the WHT code and rate with a reason code, and route exceptions to TDT - the preventive validation the SOP currently assumes rather than checks.

WD+2 extract, reversal and prior-month filter, payment file, FC approval and CROWN request chained into one scheduled flow with TDT reviewing the exceptions and the total.

Annual listing, reconciliation to the twelve payment files, vendor details and the form fields produced by script; FC review and CFO signature captured in one approval with the lodgement route confirmed with the ATO.

Flow · Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments · TAX-02.3 - Claude recommendation · Under review

AI in process improvementFlux commentary and trend assistant
Flow · Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review · TAX-02.4 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Draft the flux commentary and surface trends from the analysed GL population (TAX-07) for the TDT, Financial Controller and Deloitte review, with the review template populated automatically.

AI in digitalizationTax balance reconciliation monitor
Flow · Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 7 - Post-filing and reporting · TAX-02.7 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Monthly scripted reconciliation of the corporate tax receivable and payable GLs with ageing by tax year, refunds matched to returns, extended to VAT and WHT payable GLs.

AI in digitalizationSingle VAT data-to-return pipeline
Phase · VAT (Vietnam) · TAX-03 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Flags at posting, scheduled extraction and FPT download, automated upload to Intela, e-invoice reconciliation and an approval flow that marks the return complete in Intela and pre-fills the CROWN payment.

AI in process improvementInput VAT validity flags at posting
Flow · VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 2 - Transaction processing and VAT posting · TAX-03.2 - Claude recommendation · Under review

PENDING, reversal / correction and sponsorship lines flagged once at posting so the monthly return review starts from a classified ledger.

AI in digitalizationScheduled VAT data pack to Intela
Flow · VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 4 - VAT data gathering · TAX-03.4 - Claude recommendation · Under review

SAP extracts, FPT reports and the sum-netting report collected by scheduled scripts, uploaded to the Intela information request and Deloitte Vietnam notified without the macro workbook or manual fallback.

AI in process improvementE-invoice to SAP output VAT reconciliation
Flow · VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 5 - Return preparation and review · TAX-03.5 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Reconcile FPT e-invoices to SAP output VAT and present the exceptions and pre-flagged items to TDT, so the review of Deloitte's draft focuses on judgement items.

AI in digitalizationGroup tax reporting workbench for TDT
Phase · Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · TAX-04 - Claude recommendation · Under review

One place for the quarterly TRT input, the RTP loads and tie-outs, the Group Tax threshold flags and the pushdown journal pack, replacing the mix of TRT screens, Excel mapping tables and email confirmations.

AI in digitalizationTRT input assistant for Tier 3 and 4
Flow · Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT · TAX-04.1 - Claude recommendation · Under review

NA1201 pre-populated from the prior RTP and NA1101, review checklist and questionnaire in a Power App, and the quarterly confirmation to Group Tax generated from it.

AI in process improvementRTP tie-out and threshold checker
Flow · Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · TAX-04.2 - Claude recommendation · Under review

Load the RTP template tables into the TRT by script, tie out to the TARF, NA1602 and NA1301 reports and raise the Group Tax threshold flags automatically.

AI in digitalizationPushdown journal pack from the TRT
Flow · Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · TAX-04.3 - Claude recommendation · Under review

One scheduled run after the Briefing Note: journal and TARF exports per entity, local finance approval flow, BlackLine template pre-filled and the SAP-to-TARF reconciliation by script.

Tax GL Analyzer (Group IT), Copilot agent / chain prompting (TAX-11)
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments · step 4
Copilot agent / chain prompting (TAX-11)Chain prompting classifies the tax-only asset candidates against the capitalisation rules, for Tax to confirm.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments · step 5

Prepare local adjustmentsExtend the analyzer to the remaining CIT pack categories and to adjustment and exception identification (TAX-02, TAX-14), generating the schedule per UCM category with AI-proposed rule updates approved by the analyst (TAX-05).
Tax GL Analyzer, Copilot agent, scheduled chain prompt (TAX-12), Excel schedules
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments · step 5
Copilot agent, scheduled chain prompt (TAX-12)A scheduled chain prompt drafts the local adjustment schedules from the Tax GL Analyzer output for the preparer to review.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments · step 6
Upload to IntelaNotify the analyst when the reviewed file is ready for a final sanity check (TAX-16), then upload from the landing zone to the Intela information request.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review · step 1

Prepare computation and UCMDraft the computation and pre-fill the return form for one pilot market from the analyzer output (TAX-15, TAX-21), with Deloitte reviewing rather than preparing from scratch.
Tax GL Analyzer output, Excel / Intela template, Deloitte review
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review · step 2
Review computationPopulate the CIT review template from the SAP extracts and the schedules automatically and flag variances above a materiality threshold for TDT review.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review · step 3
Explain movementsUse AI trend analysis of the analysed GL population (TAX-07) to draft the flux commentary against the prior year for the Financial Controller and Deloitte discussion.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review · step 3
Copilot in Excel / Power BICopilot drafts the explanation of movements between current and prior year from the computation, for the reviewer to edit.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 5 - Disclosures, presentation and filing · step 2
Copilot in ExcelCopilot summarises the tax positions against last year and lists the items that changed, ahead of the CFO review.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 5 - Disclosures, presentation and filing · step 4
Copilot in PowerPointCopilot drafts the CFO presentation of the computation from the approved workbook, for TDT to review.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 7 - Post-filing and reporting · step 4
Verify refund and clear bankMatch the tax refund on the bank statement to the filed return automatically and propose the clearing journal; variances routed to Deloitte.
Python, SAP bank statement data, BlackLine journal
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 7 - Post-filing and reporting · step 5
Reconcile tax balancesReconcile GL 17140100 and 22340120 by script monthly with ageing by tax year, extended to the VAT and WHT payable GLs, instead of the pre-Q4 manual review.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 7 - Post-filing and reporting · step 5
Copilot in ExcelCopilot explains the reconciling items between the tax balances and the ledger and drafts the reconciliation commentary.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 2 - Transaction processing and VAT posting · step 2

Validate and assess input VATFlag at posting the items without a legitimate VAT invoice (PENDING), the reversal / correction pairs and the sponsorship or HCP donation lines, so they are classified once instead of at return time.
Rule set in Coupa / SAP posting validation, Python
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 2 - Transaction processing and VAT posting · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the Vietnam VAT rules checks the supplier invoice for valid e-invoice details and flags input VAT that may not be deductible.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 4 - VAT data gathering · step 1
Extract VAT dataReplace the macro workbook and its manual fallback with a scheduled extraction of the TB, VAT GLs, input and output lists, donation GL, full GL and bank GL after period close.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 4 - VAT data gathering · step 2

Collect supporting dataDownload the FPT e-invoice reports by scheduled script with the portal credentials held in a managed vault rather than in the SOP; sum-netting report requested from Controlling automatically.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 4 - VAT data gathering · step 3
Upload and notify DeloitteUpload the data pack to the Intela information request and notify Deloitte Vietnam automatically once the extracts are complete.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 5 - Return preparation and review · step 2
Review adjustmentsReconcile the FPT e-invoices to SAP output VAT by script and present the pre-flagged PENDING, reversal and sponsorship items so TDT reviews exceptions rather than the full ledger.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 5 - Return preparation and review · step 3
Prepare approval summaryGenerate the approval summary from the reviewed return and capture the CFC and CFO approval in a Power Apps approval that marks the return complete in Intela.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 5 - Return preparation and review · step 3
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the approval summary for the CFC / CFO from the VAT return and the adjustments reviewed.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 7 - Payment and post-filing · step 1
Raise VAT paymentPre-fill the CROWN payment request from the approved return and the market bank table.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 7 - Payment and post-filing · step 4
Request write-offGenerate the write-off request for excluded non-allowable sponsorship VAT from the exclusion list at filing.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 7 - Payment and post-filing · step 4
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the write-off request with the amount, reason and supporting references for approval.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 7 - Payment and post-filing · step 5
Post adjustments and reconcilePropose the adjustment journal from the return reconciliation for R2R to post through BlackLine.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT · step 2

Input forecast PBT and permanent differencesPre-populate the NA1201 data collection form from the prior-year RTP and the NA1101 report by script; TDT confirms the forecast PBT and permanent differences.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT · step 2
Copilot in ExcelCopilot compares the forecast PBT and permanent differences with the ERH feed and last quarter and flags outliers before input.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT · step 4
Regional lead review and confirmation to Group TaxRun the regional lead review checklist and the Tier 3 questionnaire in a Power App and generate the quarterly confirmation to Group Tax from it.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT · step 4
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent checks the regional lead confirmation against the TRT inputs and drafts the email to Group Tax.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · step 3
Input PYA current taxMap the RTP template TDT Summary tab (Table 3) to the TRT input by script so the current tax prior year adjustment is loaded for confirmation rather than keyed.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · step 3
Copilot in ExcelCopilot reads the RTP TDT Summary and flags current-tax differences against the provision before input into the TRT.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · step 4
Input PYA deferred taxLoad the deferred tax prior year adjustment from Tables 1 and 2 of the TDT Summary tab the same way.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · step 6

Regional lead check and confirmationTie out the RTP summary to the TARF, NA1602 and NA1301 reports automatically and raise the Group Tax flags (two returns in a year, PYA over USD 2m, OCI / equity figures, deferred 'other' over USD 1m) without a manual check.
Python, TRT reports, Power Automate email to gtr@
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT · step 6
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent checks the TARF and report outputs against the checklist and drafts the confirmation email to Group Tax.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 2

Extract the suggested SAP journal and TARF from the TRTExport the suggested SAP journal and the TARF for every Tier 3 and 4 entity in one scheduled run after the Briefing Note, named by entity and period.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 2
Copilot in ExcelCopilot checks the extracted SAP journal against the TARF and drafts the instructions for local finance.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 3

Inform local finance and obtain confirmationSend the proposed journal and TARF to local finance as a Power Apps approval; disagreement, closed accounts or alternative journals are captured as variance reasons and routed to Group Tax.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 3
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the request to local finance for confirmation and tracks the replies in the thread.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 4

Create the manual journal in SAP via BlackLinePre-fill the BlackLine journal template (header text, line text, reason code General Tax, document type SA, accounts and posting keys) from the TRT export with the three attachments linked.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95) · step 5

Reconcile SAP balance sheet to the TARFReconcile the four SAP tax GLs (26310100, 14600100, 22340120, 17140100) to the TARF by script using the TARF-to-ERH-to-SAP mapping, with issues sent to Group Tax.

WHT engine from invoice to certificateVendor tax rules, service classification, WHT determination, treaty validation and exception routing before posting, feeding the monthly payment file, the annual return and WHT certificates from the same calculation data - the Miro future state (Aug 2026).
Withholding Tax (Australia) · Phase 3 - WHT review and posting

WHT determination assistant at invoice captureClassify the vendor, service and treaty position at invoice capture, propose the WHT code and rate with a reason code, and route exceptions to TDT - the preventive validation the SOP currently assumes rather than checks.
Withholding Tax (Australia) · Phase 5 - Monthly WHT remittance

Monthly WHT remittance pack built unattendedWD+2 extract, reversal and prior-month filter, payment file, FC approval and CROWN request chained into one scheduled flow with TDT reviewing the exceptions and the total.
Withholding Tax (Australia) · Phase 6 - Annual WHT filing

Annual WHT return assembled from the monthly filesAnnual listing, reconciliation to the twelve payment files, vendor details and the form fields produced by script; FC review and CFO signature captured in one approval with the lodgement route confirmed with the ATO.

Tax GL Analyzer as the CIT pack engine, piloted end-to-end in one marketGroup IT builds from Tax-supplied rules (TAX-17), fed by the R2R fixed asset, vendor and cost centre data (TAX-19, TAX-20), scaled across categories and regions (TAX-02, TAX-03) and taken to a drafted computation for a pilot market shown to Group Tax (TAX-15, TAX-21).
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 3 - Tax data and local adjustments

Tax GL Analyzer scaled to the full CIT pack with AI on the unclassified linesRule-based analyzer across all CIT pack categories (TAX-02) with AI summarising and categorising the 'requires human analysis' lines (TAX-04), proposing rule updates for approval (TAX-05), run as a scheduled chain prompt for consistent output (TAX-11, TAX-12).
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 4 - Computation and review

Flux commentary and trend assistantDraft the flux commentary and surface trends from the analysed GL population (TAX-07) for the TDT, Financial Controller and Deloitte review, with the review template populated automatically.
Corporate Income Tax (Australia AU10) · Phase 7 - Post-filing and reporting

Tax balance reconciliation monitorMonthly scripted reconciliation of the corporate tax receivable and payable GLs with ageing by tax year, refunds matched to returns, extended to VAT and WHT payable GLs.

Single VAT data-to-return pipelineFlags at posting, scheduled extraction and FPT download, automated upload to Intela, e-invoice reconciliation and an approval flow that marks the return complete in Intela and pre-fills the CROWN payment.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 2 - Transaction processing and VAT posting
Input VAT validity flags at postingPENDING, reversal / correction and sponsorship lines flagged once at posting so the monthly return review starts from a classified ledger.

Scheduled VAT data pack to IntelaSAP extracts, FPT reports and the sum-netting report collected by scheduled scripts, uploaded to the Intela information request and Deloitte Vietnam notified without the macro workbook or manual fallback.
VAT (Vietnam) · Phase 5 - Return preparation and review

E-invoice to SAP output VAT reconciliationReconcile FPT e-invoices to SAP output VAT and present the exceptions and pre-flagged items to TDT, so the review of Deloitte's draft focuses on judgement items.

Group tax reporting workbench for TDTOne place for the quarterly TRT input, the RTP loads and tie-outs, the Group Tax threshold flags and the pushdown journal pack, replacing the mix of TRT screens, Excel mapping tables and email confirmations.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT

TRT input assistant for Tier 3 and 4NA1201 pre-populated from the prior RTP and NA1101, review checklist and questionnaire in a Power App, and the quarterly confirmation to Group Tax generated from it.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT
RTP tie-out and threshold checkerLoad the RTP template tables into the TRT by script, tie out to the TARF, NA1602 and NA1301 reports and raise the Group Tax threshold flags automatically.
Group Tax Reporting (Tier 3 and 4 entities) · Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95)

Pushdown journal pack from the TRTOne scheduled run after the Briefing Note: journal and TARF exports per entity, local finance approval flow, BlackLine template pre-filled and the SAP-to-TARF reconciliation by script.

Related TPIs · Tax GL Analyzer, Capital Assets 29

August 2026 TPI session and project deck · feasibility flag per item: Feasible · Under review · Not feasible · Can be explored in the future · items shown on the map are marked
IDOpportunityPractical action and stakeholder valueCategoryCross-towerFeasibilityBasis for the flag · LT remarks
TAX-01on mapRule-based Tax GL Analyzer for capital assetsRules supplied by Tax, tool built by Group IT. Live and proven on IT and Telecommunication this year.AutomationAutomationTax (TDT), Group IT: Rule-based Tax GL Analyzer for capital assets.Feasiblefrom session feedbackLive and proven on IT and Telecommunication this year
TAX-02on mapScale to the remaining tax categories in the CIT Tax PackSeven to nine or more categories per country need the same analysis. Same pack, same method, same tool.AutomationAutomation—Feasiblefrom session feedbackSame pack, same method, same tool - scale to the remaining categories
TAX-03Scale to the other regionsThe CIT Tax Pack is already standardised across APAC, LATAM and India, which is the foundation for regional scale-up.AutomationAutomationTax (TDT), regional tax teams: Scale to the other regions.Under reviewfrom session feedbackCIT pack is standardised across APAC, LATAM and India, but other regions review on materiality (see TAX-25)
TAX-04on mapAI summarises and categorises lines the rules cannot classifyWhere the tool returns 'requires human analysis', AI summarises the item, categorises it and reviews the trend.AIAutomation · AI—Under reviewfrom session feedbackNext-step exploration: AI on the 'requires human analysis' lines
TAX-05on mapAI proposes rule-set updates for analyst approvalAI finds similar cases and proposes a new rule. Nothing changes without a person approving it.AIAutomation · AI—Under reviewfrom session feedbackRule proposals need an approval step; nothing changes without a person approving
TAX-06Capture rule knowledge in the rule set rather than in one personStoring approved cases in the rules strengthens continuity and lets others maintain them when the owner is away.Process Improvement—Feasiblefrom session feedbackProcess change only - store approved cases in the rule set
TAX-07AI trend analysis to support finance decision-makingUse the analysed population to surface trends that help the finance team, beyond the reclassification itself.AIAITax (TDT), finance: AI trend analysis to support finance decision-making.Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedbackBeyond the reclassification itself; depends on the analysed population being in place
TAX-08on mapExplore Claude for the remaining analysisStated as the next step: test whether it can assist with the analysis the rule-based tool does not cover.AIAI—Feasiblefrom session feedbackStated in session as the agreed next step
TAX-09on mapMove to agentic AI once SAP interfacing and governance allowRaised as the likely end state. Not feasible today because agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and governance is unresolved.AIAutomation · AITax (TDT), Global Digital: Move to agentic AI once SAP interfacing and governance allow.Not feasiblefrom session feedbackNot feasible today: agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and governance is unresolved
TAX-10on mapInterim route: extract to SharePoint, then analyse with an agentExtract from SAP by script, land the data in SharePoint, and let an agent plug into Copilot to analyse it there.AIAutomation · AITax (TDT), Global Digital: Interim route: extract to SharePoint, then analyse with an agent.Under reviewfrom session feedbackInterim route proposed in session: SAP extract to SharePoint, Copilot agent analyses there
TAX-11on mapUse chain prompting or an agent builder for consistent outputAddresses the consistency problem directly: chain prompting returns the same result repeatedly against defined rules.AIAITax (TDT), Global Digital: Use chain prompting or an agent builder for consistent output.Feasiblefrom session feedbackOffered by Global Digital in session as the fix for consistency
TAX-12on mapSchedule the chain prompt so runs are unattendedRemoves the need to trigger the analysis manually each cycle.AutomationAutomation · AI—Feasiblefrom session feedbackFollows once the chain prompt (TAX-11) is in place
TAX-13on mapExtend the tool to capital allowance identificationWith the fixed asset register, PO description, vendor master, asset class and cost centre available, qualifying capital allowance can be identified.AutomationAutomationTax (TDT), R2R: Extend the tool to capital allowance identification.Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedbackExtension; needs fixed asset, PO, vendor and cost centre data from R2R (TAX-19)
TAX-14on mapExtend to tax adjustments and exception identificationSince all GL items are already in the tool, use it to identify penalties, fines, add-backs and other adjustments.AutomationAutomationTax (TDT), R2R: Extend to tax adjustments and exception identification.Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedbackExtension of the existing tool to adjustments and exceptions
TAX-15on mapDraft tax computation and auto-fill of tax formsMirror the tax form for one pilot market and auto-fill it, taking the case end to end rather than stopping at analysis.AutomationAutomation · AITax (TDT), Group Tax: Draft tax computation and auto-fill of tax forms.Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedbackEnd-to-end for one pilot market; depends on the Group Tax mandate (TAX-21, TAX-24)
TAX-16on mapNotify the analyst when the reviewed file is readyPart of the target design: the tool notifies the user, who performs a final sanity check before release to the tax agent.AutomationAutomation—Feasiblefrom session feedbackPart of the target design
TAX-17Group IT builds from Tax-supplied rulesThe proven model: Tax owns the rules, Group IT builds the solution. Delivered in two to three months once funded.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), Group IT: Group IT builds from Tax-supplied rules.Feasiblefrom session feedbackProven model; two to three months once funded
TAX-18Secure data science support for the next phaseThe team asked directly for exploration support, keeping the split of Tax-supplied rules and a technically built solution.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), data science team: Secure data science support for the next phase.Under reviewfrom session feedbackSupport requested in session - not yet confirmed
TAX-19on mapSource fixed asset, vendor and cost centre data from R2RFixed asset register, PO description, vendor master, asset class and cost centre are the inputs the extension needs.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), R2R: Source fixed asset, vendor and cost centre data from R2R.Feasiblefrom session feedbackInputs exist in the fixed asset register, vendor master and cost centres
TAX-20on mapLeverage the Global Fixed Asset Dashboard already in buildReferenced directly in session as an existing source of the asset information the tax extension would need.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), R2R GFS CAPEX: Leverage the Global Fixed Asset Dashboard already in build.Feasiblefrom session feedbackGlobal Fixed Asset Dashboard already in build
TAX-21on mapRun one market as a pilot to demonstrate to Group TaxGroup Tax needs to see it working. A pilot market shows the method and the cost case in one place.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), Group Tax: Run one market as a pilot to demonstrate to Group Tax.Feasiblefrom session feedbackPilot market to demonstrate method and cost case to Group Tax
TAX-22on mapRenegotiate third-party tax agent fees as work moves in houseWork returning in house reduces what the agent does. The market bears the fee under a global contract, so the saving is real.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), Group Tax, market finance: Renegotiate third-party tax agent fees as work moves in house.Under reviewfrom session feedbackSaving is real but sits under a global contract; needs the mandate decision
TAX-23Align with the SFO model on who scales the analyzerTax is working concurrently with the SFO model and building in house, expecting to meet in the middle on who delivers.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), Group Tax: Align with the SFO model on who scales the analyzer.Under reviewfrom session feedbackConcurrent with the SFO model; delivery split to be agreed
TAX-24on mapResolve the global mandate on the third-party analysis splitScaling is dependent on a global decision about how much analysis is directed to the third-party provider.Cross-Tower CollaborationGroup Tax, LT: Resolve the global mandate on the third-party analysis split.Under reviewfrom session feedbackGlobal decision on the third-party analysis split - prerequisite for scaling
TAX-25Work with GPDD and regional leads on scalabilityEngagement is already close. Other regions review on materiality rather than line by line, so the approach does not transfer unchanged.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), GPDD, regional tax teams: Work with GPDD and regional leads on scalability.Under reviewfrom session feedbackApproach does not transfer unchanged to regions reviewing on materiality
TAX-26on mapWork with Global Digital on agentic AI governance and SAP interfacingThe blocker is not the idea but the platform: agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and has no agreed governance yet.Cross-Tower CollaborationAITax (TDT), Global Digital: Work with Global Digital on agentic AI governance and SAP interfacing.Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedbackPlatform blocker: no SAP interfacing or governance for agentic AI yet
TAX-27on mapDraw on Global Digital enablement for prompting and agent buildingChain prompting, agent builder and scheduling techniques were offered in session as a way to reach consistent output.Cross-Tower CollaborationAITax (TDT), Global Digital: Draw on Global Digital enablement for prompting and agent building.Feasiblefrom session feedbackEnablement offered by Global Digital in session
TAX-28Share the rule-based analysis method with other process towersAn explicit invitation from the presenter: any tower doing rule-driven data analysis can replicate the same approach.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), all process towers: Share the rule-based analysis method with other process towers.Feasiblefrom session feedbackExplicit invitation from the presenter; method is reusable
TAX-29Track the USD 5,000 to USD 10,000 threshold decisionA management-level discussion. Raising the threshold pushes more assets into the P&L and increases the reclassification population.Cross-Tower CollaborationTax (TDT), Group Accounting: Track the USD 5,000 to USD 10,000 threshold decision.Under reviewfrom session feedbackManagement-level threshold decision (USD 5,000 to 10,000)

Column I (Feasibility / Relevance Status) and column J (Remarks) of the register were empty in the file supplied, so the flag is derived from the session and project-owner feedback recorded against each item; once the LT fills the dropdown the page takes the register value and shows the remark.

headers: Basis for the flag · LT remarks
rows: Rule-based Tax GL Analyzer for capital assets
Rules supplied by Tax, tool built by Group IT. Live and proven on IT and Telecommunication this year.
Tax (TDT), Group IT: Rule-based Tax GL Analyzer for capital assets.
Live and proven on IT and Telecommunication this year
Scale to the remaining tax categories in the CIT Tax Pack
Seven to nine or more categories per country need the same analysis. Same pack, same method, same tool.
Same pack, same method, same tool - scale to the remaining categories
The CIT Tax Pack is already standardised across APAC, LATAM and India, which is the foundation for regional scale-up.
Tax (TDT), regional tax teams: Scale to the other regions.
CIT pack is standardised across APAC, LATAM and India, but other regions review on materiality (see TAX-25)
AI summarises and categorises lines the rules cannot classify
Where the tool returns 'requires human analysis', AI summarises the item, categorises it and reviews the trend.
Next-step exploration: AI on the 'requires human analysis' lines
AI proposes rule-set updates for analyst approval
AI finds similar cases and proposes a new rule. Nothing changes without a person approving it.
Rule proposals need an approval step; nothing changes without a person approving
Capture rule knowledge in the rule set rather than in one person
Storing approved cases in the rules strengthens continuity and lets others maintain them when the owner is away.
Process change only - store approved cases in the rule set
AI trend analysis to support finance decision-making
Use the analysed population to surface trends that help the finance team, beyond the reclassification itself.
Tax (TDT), finance: AI trend analysis to support finance decision-making.
Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedback
Beyond the reclassification itself; depends on the analysed population being in place
Explore Claude for the remaining analysis
Stated as the next step: test whether it can assist with the analysis the rule-based tool does not cover.
Stated in session as the agreed next step
Move to agentic AI once SAP interfacing and governance allow
Raised as the likely end state. Not feasible today because agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and governance is unresolved.
Tax (TDT), Global Digital: Move to agentic AI once SAP interfacing and governance allow.
Not feasible today: agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and governance is unresolved
Interim route: extract to SharePoint, then analyse with an agent
Extract from SAP by script, land the data in SharePoint, and let an agent plug into Copilot to analyse it there.
Tax (TDT), Global Digital: Interim route: extract to SharePoint, then analyse with an agent.
Interim route proposed in session: SAP extract to SharePoint, Copilot agent analyses there
Use chain prompting or an agent builder for consistent output
Addresses the consistency problem directly: chain prompting returns the same result repeatedly against defined rules.
Tax (TDT), Global Digital: Use chain prompting or an agent builder for consistent output.
Offered by Global Digital in session as the fix for consistency
Schedule the chain prompt so runs are unattended
Removes the need to trigger the analysis manually each cycle.
Follows once the chain prompt (TAX-11) is in place
Extend the tool to capital allowance identification
With the fixed asset register, PO description, vendor master, asset class and cost centre available, qualifying capital allowance can be identified.
Tax (TDT), R2R: Extend the tool to capital allowance identification.
Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedback
Extension; needs fixed asset, PO, vendor and cost centre data from R2R (TAX-19)
Extend to tax adjustments and exception identification
Since all GL items are already in the tool, use it to identify penalties, fines, add-backs and other adjustments.
Tax (TDT), R2R: Extend to tax adjustments and exception identification.
Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedback
Extension of the existing tool to adjustments and exceptions
Draft tax computation and auto-fill of tax forms
Mirror the tax form for one pilot market and auto-fill it, taking the case end to end rather than stopping at analysis.
Tax (TDT), Group Tax: Draft tax computation and auto-fill of tax forms.
Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedback
End-to-end for one pilot market; depends on the Group Tax mandate (TAX-21, TAX-24)
Notify the analyst when the reviewed file is ready
Part of the target design: the tool notifies the user, who performs a final sanity check before release to the tax agent.
Group IT builds from Tax-supplied rules
The proven model: Tax owns the rules, Group IT builds the solution. Delivered in two to three months once funded.
Tax (TDT), Group IT: Group IT builds from Tax-supplied rules.
Proven model; two to three months once funded
Secure data science support for the next phase
The team asked directly for exploration support, keeping the split of Tax-supplied rules and a technically built solution.
Tax (TDT), data science team: Secure data science support for the next phase.
Support requested in session - not yet confirmed
Source fixed asset, vendor and cost centre data from R2R
Fixed asset register, PO description, vendor master, asset class and cost centre are the inputs the extension needs.
Tax (TDT), R2R: Source fixed asset, vendor and cost centre data from R2R.
Inputs exist in the fixed asset register, vendor master and cost centres
Leverage the Global Fixed Asset Dashboard already in build
Referenced directly in session as an existing source of the asset information the tax extension would need.
Tax (TDT), R2R GFS CAPEX: Leverage the Global Fixed Asset Dashboard already in build.
Global Fixed Asset Dashboard already in build
Run one market as a pilot to demonstrate to Group Tax
Group Tax needs to see it working. A pilot market shows the method and the cost case in one place.
Tax (TDT), Group Tax: Run one market as a pilot to demonstrate to Group Tax.
Pilot market to demonstrate method and cost case to Group Tax
Renegotiate third-party tax agent fees as work moves in house
Work returning in house reduces what the agent does. The market bears the fee under a global contract, so the saving is real.
Tax (TDT), Group Tax, market finance: Renegotiate third-party tax agent fees as work moves in house.
Saving is real but sits under a global contract; needs the mandate decision
Align with the SFO model on who scales the analyzer
Tax is working concurrently with the SFO model and building in house, expecting to meet in the middle on who delivers.
Tax (TDT), Group Tax: Align with the SFO model on who scales the analyzer.
Concurrent with the SFO model; delivery split to be agreed
Resolve the global mandate on the third-party analysis split
Scaling is dependent on a global decision about how much analysis is directed to the third-party provider.
Group Tax, LT: Resolve the global mandate on the third-party analysis split.
Global decision on the third-party analysis split - prerequisite for scaling
Work with GPDD and regional leads on scalability
Engagement is already close. Other regions review on materiality rather than line by line, so the approach does not transfer unchanged.
Tax (TDT), GPDD, regional tax teams: Work with GPDD and regional leads on scalability.
Approach does not transfer unchanged to regions reviewing on materiality
Work with Global Digital on agentic AI governance and SAP interfacing
The blocker is not the idea but the platform: agentic AI cannot interface with SAP and has no agreed governance yet.
Tax (TDT), Global Digital: Work with Global Digital on agentic AI governance and SAP interfacing.
Can be explored in the futurefrom session feedback
Platform blocker: no SAP interfacing or governance for agentic AI yet
Draw on Global Digital enablement for prompting and agent building
Chain prompting, agent builder and scheduling techniques were offered in session as a way to reach consistent output.
Tax (TDT), Global Digital: Draw on Global Digital enablement for prompting and agent building.
Enablement offered by Global Digital in session
Share the rule-based analysis method with other process towers
An explicit invitation from the presenter: any tower doing rule-driven data analysis can replicate the same approach.
Tax (TDT), all process towers: Share the rule-based analysis method with other process towers.
Explicit invitation from the presenter; method is reusable
Track the USD 5,000 to USD 10,000 threshold decision
A management-level discussion. Raising the threshold pushes more assets into the P&L and increases the reclassification population.
Tax (TDT), Group Accounting: Track the USD 5,000 to USD 10,000 threshold decision.

Intercompany transactions close first and R2R monitors the towers' month-end tasks and closes SAP by WD+2; legal entity and intercompany data are loaded into ERH, reconciled to SAP, locked and promoted to GFR by WD+4, from where they roll up into Group Consolidation & Reporting; balance sheet accounts are reconciled in BlackLine by risk rating, certified and approved, then reviewed by Controlling, FP&A Ops and FP&A Comm; the balance sheet integrity packs are signed off by the CFO. Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 1
Manual SAP data extraction for the BSR working file is repetitive and time consuming (Python extraction piloted; being globalised with Global R2R and Digital Delivery to run on a virtual machine)

Python extraction of the SAP data into the BSR working file (piloted, being globalised on a virtual machine), with an AI completeness and variance check on the supporting documents and a flag on oversized attachments.
Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 1
Excessive supporting documents increase file size and hurt working-file performance and storage space (under review for improvement)
AI completeness check flags oversized or duplicate attachments and the supporting documents are linked rather than embedded, so the working file stays small (with the BSR automation).
Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 2

Journals in BlackLine show a posting error although posted in SAP (SAP-BlackLine interface performance); the team checks they are not reprocessed and the BL administrator re-marks them Posted via a Journal Status file import - permanent fix pending from AZ IT

Automated reconciliation of the BlackLine journal posting status against SAP, auto-correcting journals confirmed as posted instead of the manual Journal Status file import (pending the permanent AZ IT fix).
Flow 2 - BSI Review, SOX Non-Hubs (8.3.2.35.3) · step 1
Manual process - SOX entities are not in scope for the auto-generated Power BI BSI pack used for control governance
Extend the auto-generated Power BI BSI pack to the SOX non-hub entities CN10 and CN20, removing the manual spreadsheet build for that scope.
