ERH Reporting · Flow 1 - Prepare Legal Entity Financial Statements (8.3.4.1) · step 2
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the prior MOTs and the ERH guidance drafts the MOT narrative from the current extracts, for R2R to review.
ERH Reporting · Flow 1 - Prepare Legal Entity Financial Statements (8.3.4.1) · step 3

Validate and reconcile to SAPAutomated completeness check of the new ERH 101 / 102 lines against SAP each quarter, with the exceptions and variances over USD100k listed for the reviewer instead of a manual check.
Python / Speedy Bot extension, Power BI
ERH Reporting · Flow 1 - Prepare Legal Entity Financial Statements (8.3.4.1) · step 3
Copilot in ExcelCopilot explains the ERH vs SAP variances over USD100k from the Speedy Bot output and drafts the override request where a validation cannot be cleared.
ERH Reporting · Flow 2 - Intercompany ERH Reporting (8.3.2.52) · step 3
Resolve mismatchesAI drafts the mismatch explanation and the counterparty query from the ICT report, and tracks the counterparty replies before the WD+3 lock.
ERH Reporting · Flow 2 - Intercompany ERH Reporting (8.3.2.52) · step 3
Copilot in OutlookCopilot drafts the counterparty query for each mismatch from the ICT report and summarises the replies received.
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 1

Prepare reconciliationPython extraction of the SAP data into the BSR working file (piloted, being globalised on a virtual machine), with an AI completeness and variance check on the supporting documents and a flag on oversized attachments.
Python on a virtual machine, AI document check
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 1
Copilot in ExcelCopilot summarises the open items ageing and drafts the reconciliation commentary from the working file.
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 2

Resolve differences or issuesAutomated reconciliation of the BlackLine journal posting status against SAP, auto-correcting journals confirmed as posted instead of the manual Journal Status file import (pending the permanent AZ IT fix).
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 1 - Reconcile GL and Sub-Ledger Accounts (8.3.2.30 and 8.3.2.31) · step 3
Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)An agent grounded on the BSI Standard (FSC015-013) pre-checks the reconciliation against the approval checklist and lists the gaps for the approver.
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 2 - Resolve Reconciliation Actions (8.3.2.33) · step 1
Download action reportsSchedule the action plan reports from BlackLine and deliver them to the team lead automatically at WD+5 and WD+15.
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 2 - Resolve Reconciliation Actions (8.3.2.33) · step 2
Follow up action ownersPower Automate sends the owner reminders from the action report and tracks the responses; the team lead only handles the overdue items.
BSR Preparation and Approval · Flow 2 - Resolve Reconciliation Actions (8.3.2.33) · step 2

R2R-17Define users, access rights and refresh SLADocument the intended users, decisions, row-level access, posting-to-refresh time gap and visible refresh status before final dashboard adoption.Process ImprovementAutomation · AIR2R, FP&A Ops, controllers, local finance: Define users, access rights and refresh SLA.FeasibleExisting July register · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-18AI accounting guardrailAllow AI to retrieve, summarise and flag patterns only; prohibit it from deciding accrual eligibility, changing rules, removing lines, certifying journals or posting entries.Process ImprovementAutomation · AI—FeasibleExisting July register · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-19Automated stakeholder access and distribution maintenanceSynchronise dashboard access and notification recipients with an approved entity-to-owner master so new entities do not depend on preparer-maintained lists.AutomationAutomation · AIR2R, identity/access team, local finance: Automated stakeholder access and distribution maintenance.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-20AI overlap detection across accrual populationsIdentify probable overlap among PO accrual, stuck invoice, pending receipt and adjacent P2P or Controlling populations for reviewer resolution.AIAutomation · AIR2R, P2P, Controlling: AI overlap detection across accrual populations.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-21AI classification of PO descriptionsClassify unstructured PO descriptions into governed expense and accrual categories to improve filtering and exception review, with user confirmation.AIAutomation · AIR2R, Procurement, FP&A Ops: AI classification of PO descriptions.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-22Automated accrual roll-forward exception checkMatch prior accruals to receipts, invoices, reversals and repostings and flag items that remain open beyond the expected cycle.AutomationAutomation · AIR2R, P2P: Automated accrual roll-forward exception check.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-23AI data-quality root-cause clusteringGroup recurring unmapped fields, failed loads and reconciliation breaks by source and entity so owners can prioritise permanent fixes.AIAutomation · AIR2R, platform team, source-system owners: AI data-quality root-cause clustering.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports
R2R-24AI forecast of late-receipt and reversal riskRank open accrual items likely to remain unresolved or reverse late using ageing and prior settlement patterns, for reviewer follow-up only.AIAutomation · AIR2R, P2P, local finance: AI forecast of late-receipt and reversal risk.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Coupa Accrual Reports

PRI-13AI recurring-failure root-cause analysisCluster failures by market, provider, master-data object and timing to identify the highest-value permanent fixes.AIAutomation · AIR2R Payroll, payroll providers, Global Digital: AI recurring-failure root-cause analysis.Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Payroll Interface

PRI-16Predict simulation failure risk before uploadUse prior errors and current master-data changes to rank files likely to fail, enabling targeted review before the overnight run.AIAutomation · AI—Not yet assessedAI-suggested — To be reviewed · R2R Payroll Interface

asIs.title: Controlling As-Is Process Map
asIs.html:
Controlling · Manual Journal Preparation (MJV) → Statutory Audit · the two key processes Controlling has documented; other Controlling processes named in the MIRO feedback are listed at the bottom

Controlling As-Is Process Map

Two questions for the visitor: how does GFS Controlling make sure every judgmental manual journal posted in the month-end close is needed, GSOP-compliant, approved and reviewed in the management P&L, and how does it get the statutory audit from planning to filed accounts across all the process towers each year? The answer is the journey below - the Business requests, Embedded Finance approves the cost, the GFS Controller checks the GSOP and posts in BlackLine, the GFS Manager approves and GFS FP&A reviews the P&L; the audit runs from planning and walkthroughs through PBC evidence, fieldwork, financial statement review and P13 adjustments to statutory filing. Pain points and TPI 2026 initiatives are shown where Controlling recorded them.

ai.html:
AI opportunities 4

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations built on the register items · hypotheses to validate with Controlling
AutomationGoverned journal pipeline: request form → validation → BlackLine → dashboard, scaled across towers
Key process · Manual Journal Preparation (MJV) · CTRL-01 - Claude recommendation · Can be explored

One intake form, one validation service, root cause captured at posting and one governed journal dataset published for every team posting through BlackLine (MJV-10), with natural-language Q&A over the journal history for authorised users (MJV-18).

Register MJV-10 scale the dashboard across towers: can be implemented in the future; MJV-18: AI-suggested, to be reviewed.

Process ImprovementPreventable journal elimination loop
Process · Manual Journal Preparation (MJV) · Manual Journal Request (MJV) · CTRL-01.01 - Claude recommendation · Can be explored

Dashboard (MJV-01) identifies the highest-volume requestors and causes (MJV-08); each preventable cause gets an accountable upstream owner and due date (MJV-05); benefits and recurrence are tracked automatically (MJV-21) and reviewed with CFOs monthly and AA leadership quarterly (MJV-09) - the mechanism behind the 30 percent MJV reduction target.

Register MJV-05 / 08 / 09: can be implemented in the future; MJV-21 automated benefit and recurrence tracking: AI-suggested, to be reviewed.

Cross-Tower CollaborationAudit-to-close feedback loop
Key process · Statutory Audit · CTRL-02 - Claude recommendation · Can be explored

Recurring findings and clarification reasons (AUD-13), audit-adjustment clusters (AUD-19) and the early-risk log (AUD-08) feed the MJV prevention backlog and the tower SOPs, so the statutory audit improves the next close instead of only reporting on the last one.

Register AUD-13: status blank - Controlling asked for further explanation (data held in KPMG KCC); AUD-19: AI-suggested, to be reviewed; AUD-08: can be implemented in the future.

AutomationReusable evidence-extraction factory
Process · Statutory Audit · Statutory audit end-to-end (seven sub-processes) · CTRL-02.01 - Claude recommendation · Can be explored

The PH10 SAP extraction script assessed as a reusable pattern, then approved Coupa / API routes, standard manifests and found / missing / failed logs added for the other evidence types (AUD-10) - so each tower produces its PBC population in one run instead of one-by-one downloads.

Register AUD-10: status blank - Controlling asked for further explanation; kept Under review.
